  health_authority_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the regulatory health authority that imposed or agreed to this commitment action. Determines the applicable regulatory framework and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|ANVISA|TGA|HEALTH_CANADA — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  inn varchar [note: 'The International Nonproprietary Name of the drug substance for which this commitment action applies. Provides a globally recognized, non-proprietary identifier for the active ingredient.']
  is_critical_path boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this action is on the critical path for fulfilling the parent commitment. Critical path actions, if delayed, directly impact the overall commitment due date and may trigger health authority escalation.']
  is_overdue boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this commitment action has passed its due date without completion or submission. Drives escalation workflows and health authority notification processes.']
  market_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the market for which this commitment action applies. Relevant for country-specific post-approval commitments imposed by national health authorities.']
  milestone_sequence varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number of this action within the parent commitment, enabling ordered tracking of multi-step commitments (e.g., Step 1: Protocol Submission, Step 2: Interim Report, Step 3: Final Report). Supports timeline visualization.']
  protocol_number varchar [note: 'The protocol number for the clinical or nonclinical study associated with this commitment action. Applicable when the action type is protocol submission or study-related. Enables traceability to the study protocol document.']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'The specific regulatory provision, guideline, or condition of approval that mandates or underpins this commitment action (e.g., \'21 CFR 314.81(b)(2)(vii)\', \'FDAAA Section 505(o)(3)\', \'EMA Article 14(7)\'). Provides legal traceability.']
  responsible_function varchar [note: 'The internal business function or department accountable for executing and delivering this commitment action (e.g., Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, CMC, Medical Affairs). Used for workload assignment and escalation.']
  revised_due_date date [note: 'Updated due date for this action if the original due date was formally extended or renegotiated with the health authority. Tracks timeline changes for audit and compliance purposes.']
  study_number varchar [note: 'The internal or sponsor study number associated with this commitment action, applicable when the action involves a clinical or nonclinical study (e.g., Phase 4 study, pediatric study, drug interaction study). Links to the study management system.']
  submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the deliverable for this action was formally submitted to the health authority via eCTD or other regulatory submission channel. Distinct from completion date; used for compliance verification.']
  submission_reference varchar [note: 'The formal submission reference number or dossier identifier associated with the deliverable filed for this action (e.g., NDA supplement number, variation number, eCTD submission ID). Enables cross-referencing with the submission tracking system.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area associated with the product for which this commitment action applies (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Used for portfolio-level reporting and resource allocation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this commitment action record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  vault_document_reference varchar [note: 'The document identifier in Veeva Vault RIM or eTMF for the deliverable associated with this commitment action. Enables direct navigation to the source document in the regulatory information management system.']
  waiver_justification varchar [note: 'Documented justification for waiving this commitment action, applicable when the health authority has agreed that the action is no longer necessary (e.g., due to new scientific evidence or product withdrawal). Required for audit trail.']

  Note: 'Granular action-level tracking for post-approval commitments and regulatory obligations, capturing individual tasks required to fulfill a commitment (e.g., protocol submission, interim report, final study report, label update). Tracks action description, due date, responsible function, completion date, deliverable type, and submission reference. Provides operational visibility into commitment fulfillment progress at the task level, complementing the higher-level post_approval_commitment record.'
}

Table regulatory.application_indication {
  application_indication_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the application_indication association']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the regulatory application (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, ANDA) that is seeking approval for this indication']
  indication_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the therapeutic indication being pursued in this application']
  accelerated_approval_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication received accelerated approval based on surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoints, with requirement for post-marketing confirmatory trials. True indicates accelerated approval pathway used; False indicates standard approval. [Moved from product_indication: Accelerated approval is granted per application-indication pair. The same indication may receive accelerated approval in one application but standard approval in another.]']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the health authority granted marketing authorization for this indication via this application. Null if not yet approved.']
  approval_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The regulatory jurisdiction or health authority that granted approval for this application-indication combination (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA).']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current regulatory approval status of this specific application for this specific indication. Tracks the lifecycle state of the application-indication pursuit.']
  breakthrough_designation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this application received breakthrough therapy designation for this specific indication from the FDA.']
  conditional_approval_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication received conditional marketing authorization (EMA pathway) based on less comprehensive data than normally required, with obligations to provide additional data post-approval. True indicates conditional approval; False indicates standard authorization. [Moved from product_indication: Conditional approval (EMA) is granted per application-indication pair. This is application-specific regulatory status.]']
  exclusivity_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which regulatory market exclusivity protections expire for this application-indication combination. Exclusivity is granted per application-indication pair.']
  fast_track_designation_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication combination has received FDA Fast Track designation to facilitate development and expedite review of drugs treating serious conditions and filling unmet medical needs. True indicates fast track designation granted; False indicates not designated. [Moved from product_indication: Fast track designation is granted per application-indication pair by the FDA. This is application-specific, not indication-specific.]']
  indication_added_date date [note: 'Date on which this indication was first added to this application (original submission or supplemental application date).']
  label_claim_text varchar [note: 'The exact verbatim text from the approved product label describing the indication as approved by the health authority for this specific application. Varies by application and jurisdiction.']
  orphan_designation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this application received orphan drug designation for this specific indication from the health authority.']
  priority_review_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether this product-indication application received priority review status, reducing FDA review time from standard 10 months to 6 months for drugs that offer significant improvements in safety or effectiveness. True indicates priority review granted; False indicates standard review. [Moved from product_indication: Priority review is granted per application submission, not per indication alone. This flag varies by application-indication combination.]']
  submission_sequence_number varchar [note: 'The eCTD sequence number or supplemental application number for the submission that added or modified this indication within the application lifecycle.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the regulatory approval pursuit between a regulatory application and a therapeutic indication. It captures the approval status, designation flags, exclusivity dates, and label claims that exist only in the context of a specific application seeking approval for a specific indication. Each record links one application to one indication with jurisdiction-specific approval data, supporting regulatory tracking of multi-indication applications and multi-jurisdiction indication pursuits.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical regulatory operations, a single regulatory application (NDA, BLA, MAA) can seek approval for multiple therapeutic indications, either in the original submission or via supplemental applications (sNDAs). Conversely, a single indication can be pursued across multiple applications in different jurisdictions (US NDA, EU MAA, Japan PMDA) or via different regulatory pathways. Regulatory affairs teams actively manage application-indication pairs, tracking approval status, designation flags, exclusivity dates, and label claims that are specific to each application-indication-jurisdiction combination.'
}

Table regulatory.application_site_authorization {
  application_site_authorization_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the application_site_authorization association']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the regulatory application record']
  site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the manufacturing site record']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'The regulatory approval status of this specific site for this specific application. A site may be approved for one application but pending for another. Tracks health authority acceptance of the site for manufacturing/testing this drug product.']
  capacity_allocation decimal [note: 'The percentage or amount of site capacity allocated to this specific application. Enables capacity planning and tracking when a site supports multiple applications. May be expressed as percentage of total site capacity or absolute units.']
  exclusion_date date [note: 'The date on which this manufacturing site was removed from the regulatory application (e.g., due to site closure, transfer to another CMO, or regulatory non-compliance). Enables tracking of site change history.']
  gmp_inspection_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a health authority GMP inspection of this site is required as part of the approval process for this application. Inspection requirements vary by application type, site history, and regulatory pathway.']
  inclusion_date date [note: 'The date on which this manufacturing site was included in the regulatory application dossier. Tracks when the site was added to the application (original submission or subsequent variation).']
  last_inspection_date_for_application date [note: 'The date of the most recent health authority inspection of this site specifically in the context of this application. Different from the site\'s general last inspection date, as inspections may be application-triggered.']
  manufacturing_step varchar [note: 'The specific manufacturing step or process stage assigned to this site for this application (e.g., API synthesis, formulation, sterile filling, lyophilization, primary packaging). Enables tracking of the manufacturing chain across multiple sites.']
  primary_site_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the primary manufacturing site for this application for this manufacturing step. An application may have multiple sites for the same step (backup capacity), but typically designates one as primary.']
  qualification_date date [note: 'The date on which this site was qualified by the health authority for manufacturing or testing activities related to this specific application. Qualification is site-and-application-specific.']
  site_master_file_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the Site Master File (SMF) or Drug Master File (DMF) submitted to the health authority for this site in support of this application. SMF references are application-specific.']
  site_role varchar [note: 'The specific manufacturing or testing role that this site performs for this application. A site may have different roles for different applications.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the regulatory authorization relationship between a regulatory application and a manufacturing site. It captures the site-specific role in the application (API manufacturer, drug product manufacturer, fill-finish, packaging, testing laboratory), the manufacturing step performed at each site, the regulatory approval status of that specific site for that specific application, qualification dates, and capacity allocation. Each record links one application to one manufacturing site with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical regulatory operations, a single regulatory application (NDA, BLA, MAA) routinely lists multiple manufacturing sites performing different roles in the supply chain (API synthesis at one site, drug product formulation at another, fill-finish at a third, packaging at a fourth, and testing laboratories). Conversely, a manufacturing site typically supports multiple regulatory applications across different drug products. The business actively manages these authorizations as distinct regulatory compliance artifacts, tracking site-specific approval statuses, qualification dates, manufacturing step assignments, and capacity allocations for each application-site pairing.'
}

It captures the engagement of external vendors (CROs, CMOs, regulatory consultants) to support specific regulatory applications with defined services, timelines, and deliverables. Each record links one application to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this service engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical regulatory operations, a single regulatory application (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) routinely engages multiple external vendors simultaneously: CROs conduct clinical trials, CMOs manufacture drug substance and drug product, regulatory consultants provide strategic guidance, and medical writing firms prepare dossier modules. Conversely, each vendor (especially CROs and CMOs) supports multiple applications across the company\'s portfolio. The business actively manages these engagements as distinct operational entities, tracking service type, contract value, deliverable status, and engagement timelines for each application-vendor pair.'
}

Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, a single regulatory approval (e.g., an oncology drug approved by FDA) is independently negotiated with dozens or hundreds of payer organizations (Medicare, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Anthem, etc.), each resulting in distinct coverage terms including formulary tier placement, prior authorization requirements, rebate agreements, and utilization management policies. Conversely, a single payer account covers hundreds of approved drug products across multiple therapeutic areas, each with payer-specific coverage terms. The business actively manages these payer coverage agreements as operational entities with lifecycle tracking, contract renewal cycles, and performance monitoring.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Planned|In Progress|Completed|Passed|Failed|On Hold|Cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  qualification_type varchar [note: 'Type of qualification activity performed. IQ (Installation Qualification) verifies equipment is installed correctly; OQ (Operational Qualification) verifies equipment operates within specified parameters; PQ (Performance Qualification) verifies equipment consistently produces quality product under normal operating conditions.']
  quality_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the Quality Assurance unit formally approved the qualification results and released the equipment for production use.']
  quality_approver_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the Quality Assurance (QA) representative who reviewed and approved the qualification results. Required for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.']
  regulatory_submission_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this qualification is part of a regulatory submission package (New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA), or Marketing Authorization Application (MAA)). True if qualification data will be submitted to regulatory authorities.']
  regulatory_submission_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number of the regulatory submission (New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA), Marketing Authorization Application (MAA)) that includes this qualification data.']
  risk_assessment_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number of the risk assessment document that informed the qualification strategy. Aligns with Quality by Design (QbD) principles.']
  test_cases_executed_count varchar [note: 'Total number of test cases executed during the qualification activity. Provides a measure of qualification scope and thoroughness.']
  test_cases_failed_count varchar [note: 'Number of test cases that did not meet acceptance criteria during qualification execution. Triggers investigation and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) if applicable.']
  test_cases_passed_count varchar [note: 'Number of test cases that met acceptance criteria during qualification execution. Used to calculate pass rate.']
  validation_report_number varchar [note: 'Document number of the validation report that summarizes qualification results, deviations, and conclusions. Links to the formal documentation package.']
  vendor_name varchar [note: 'Name of the vendor or Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) who supplied the equipment. Important for vendor qualification and audit trail.']
  vendor_qualification_status varchar [note: 'Current qualification status of the equipment vendor. Vendors must be qualified before their equipment can be used in Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) production.']

  Note: 'Records of equipment qualification activities including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) as required under cGMP and 21 CFR Part 211. Captures qualification type, equipment reference, qualification protocol number, execution date, qualification outcome (pass/fail), next requalification date, approver, and associated validation report reference. Tracks the qualification lifecycle for each piece of equipment to ensure GMP compliance and readiness for production use.'
}

Table manufacturing.process_parameter {
  process_parameter_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the process parameter definition. Primary key for the process parameter entity.']
  batch_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the manufacturing batch for which this parameter measurement was recorded. Links parameter measurements to specific batch execution records.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the manufacturing operator or technician who recorded or verified this parameter measurement. Required for batch record accountability and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.']
  equipment_id varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the measuring instrument, sensor, or equipment used to capture this parameter value. Required for traceability, calibration verification, and Computer System Validation (CSV) compliance.']
  manufacturing_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the deviation record if this parameter measurement triggered an Out of Specification (OOS) or Out of Trend (OOT) investigation. Links to the Quality Management System (QMS) deviation tracking system.']
  process_step_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific manufacturing process step where this parameter is measured or controlled. Links to the master process definition.']
  actual_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The actual measured or recorded value of this parameter during batch execution. Captured from Manufacturing Execution System (MES), PAT instruments, or manual operator entry. Used for batch record documentation and process validation.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operator or QA comments regarding this parameter measurement, including explanations for deviations, corrective actions taken, or contextual information for batch record documentation.']
  conformance_status varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether the measured value meets the defined control and specification limits. Out of Specification (OOS) or Out of Trend (OOT) results trigger investigation and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this process parameter record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance and data lineage.']
  criticality_justification varchar [note: 'Scientific rationale and risk assessment documentation explaining why this parameter is classified as critical or non-critical. Required for regulatory submissions and Quality by Design (QbD) documentation per ICH Q8.']
  data_integrity_hash varchar [note: 'Cryptographic hash or checksum of the parameter measurement record to ensure data integrity and detect unauthorized modifications. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature and audit trail requirements.']
  data_source_system varchar [note: 'The system or application from which this parameter data originated (e.g., SAP PP, MES, LIMS, PAT instrument software). Required for data lineage and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date on which this parameter specification version was superseded or retired. Null for currently active specifications. Supports historical batch record interpretation and regulatory compliance.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date from which this parameter specification version became effective. Used to determine which specification applies to historical batch records and supports regulatory audit trails.']
  investigation_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this parameter measurement requires formal investigation due to exceeding control or specification limits. True triggers Quality Assurance (QA) review and potential Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA).']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this process parameter record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).']
  lower_control_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'The lower boundary of the normal operating range for this parameter. Values below this trigger investigation but may not require batch rejection. Used for statistical process control and continuous process verification.']
  lower_specification_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'The minimum acceptable value for this parameter as defined in regulatory filings and approved specifications. Values below this limit may result in batch rejection or deviation investigation per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).']
  measurement_frequency varchar [note: 'The required frequency or timing for measuring this parameter during batch execution. Defines sampling plan and monitoring requirements per the approved batch record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|per_batch|hourly|per_shift|daily|on_demand|at_process_step — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  measurement_method varchar [note: 'The method by which this parameter is measured or recorded. Indicates whether data is captured through Process Analytical Technology (PAT), manual operator entry, or laboratory testing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manual_entry|automated_sensor|pat_instrument|laboratory_analysis|inline_measurement|atline_measurement|offline_measurement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  measurement_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this parameter measurement was recorded. Critical for establishing batch record chronology and supporting 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  parameter_code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric code identifying the parameter within the manufacturing process. Used for cross-referencing with Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Process Analytical Technology (PAT) instruments.']
  parameter_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the process parameter (e.g., Mixing Temperature, Compression Force, pH Level, Dissolution Rate).']
  parameter_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the parameter based on its impact on product quality. Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) have direct impact on Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs) and require stringent control per Quality by Design (QbD) principles.']
  parameter_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the parameter specification. Incremented when control limits, specification limits, or other parameter attributes are changed through the change control process. Supports regulatory change history requirements.']
  pat_enabled_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this parameter is monitored using Process Analytical Technology (PAT) instruments for real-time or near-real-time measurement and control. True if PAT is implemented for this parameter.']
  regulatory_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether deviations or out-of-specification results for this parameter must be reported to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, etc.) as part of annual product reviews or post-approval change protocols.']
  target_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The intended setpoint or target value for this parameter as defined in the master batch record or process development documentation. Represents the optimal operating point.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The measurement unit for this parameter (e.g., degrees Celsius, bar, pH units, RPM, minutes, mg/mL). Must be consistent with International System of Units (SI) or industry-standard pharmaceutical units.']
  upper_control_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'The upper boundary of the normal operating range for this parameter. Values above this trigger investigation but may not require batch rejection. Used for statistical process control and continuous process verification.']
  upper_specification_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'The maximum acceptable value for this parameter as defined in regulatory filings and approved specifications. Values above this limit may result in batch rejection or deviation investigation per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).']
  verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this parameter measurement was reviewed and verified by Quality Assurance (QA) or supervisory personnel. Part of the batch record review and release process.']
  verified_by varchar [note: 'Identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) or supervisory personnel who reviewed and verified this parameter measurement. Required for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) batch record review.']

  Note: 'Defines and records Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) and non-critical process parameters for manufacturing processes, including both the specification (target values, control limits, specification limits) from the master batch record and the actual measured values recorded during batch execution from MES, PAT instruments, or manual entry. Captures parameter name, type (CPP vs non-critical), process step, target value, control/specification limits, unit of measure, measurement frequency, PAT indicator, and per-batch actual measurements with timestamps, instrument IDs, and pass/fail status. Supports QbD principles, process validation, CPV trending, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10.'
}

Table manufacturing.process_parameter_result {
  process_parameter_result_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the process parameter result record. Primary key for this entity.']
  batch_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the manufacturing batch in which this parameter was measured. Links to the batch master record.']
  equipment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the instrument, sensor, or equipment used to capture the measurement. Links to equipment master for calibration and qualification tracking.']
  manufacturing_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the deviation or OOS investigation record if this measurement triggered a deviation. Null if no deviation occurred.']
  primary_process_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the operator or technician who recorded or verified the measurement. Links to employee master for audit trail.']
  process_parameter_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parameter definition in the master batch record or parameter library. Links to the parameter specification.']
  process_step_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific manufacturing process step or unit operation where this parameter was measured (e.g., blending, granulation, coating, fill-finish).']
  sample_id varchar [note: 'Identifier for the physical sample taken for laboratory testing, if applicable. Links to LIMS for IPC test results.']
  batch_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable batch number or lot number for traceability and regulatory reporting. Denormalized for query performance.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text comments or observations recorded by the operator or system regarding the measurement, including any contextual notes or anomalies.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this process parameter result record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'System or source from which the measurement data originated: MES (Manufacturing Execution System), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), Manual Entry, PAT System, ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook).']
  deviation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this measurement triggered a process deviation or Out of Specification (OOS) event requiring investigation and CAPA.']
  evaluation_result varchar [note: 'Result of comparing the measured value against specification limits: Pass (within limits), Fail (out of specification), Warning (approaching limits), Not Evaluated (no limits defined).']
  instrument_code varchar [note: 'Human-readable code or tag number of the instrument or equipment (e.g., TMP-101, PRS-205). Denormalized for traceability.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this process parameter result record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.']
  lower_control_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'Lower acceptable limit for the parameter as defined in the master batch record or process specification. Used for pass/fail evaluation.']
  measured_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Actual measured value of the process parameter as recorded during batch execution. This is the primary result field.']
  measurement_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the parameter was measured: Manual (operator entry), Automated (MES/SCADA), PAT (real-time analyzer), Laboratory (offline test).']
  measurement_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the parameter measurement was taken or recorded. Critical for batch chronology and process validation.']
  operator_name varchar [note: 'Name of the operator or technician who recorded the measurement. Denormalized for audit and compliance reporting.']
  parameter_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the parameter: CPP (Critical Process Parameter), Non-Critical (monitored but not critical), IPC (In-Process Control test result), PAT (Process Analytical Technology real-time measurement).']
  pat_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this measurement was captured using Process Analytical Technology (PAT) real-time monitoring tools per FDA PAT guidance.']
  record_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of the parameter result record: Active (current and valid), Superseded (replaced by corrected value), Voided (invalidated), Archived (historical, no longer active).']
  sampling_point varchar [note: 'Physical location or sampling point within the process equipment where the measurement was taken (e.g., Inlet, Outlet, Mid-Point, Probe Location).']
  target_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Target or setpoint value for the parameter as defined in the master batch record. Used for comparison and deviation detection.']
  test_method_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the validated test method or Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) used for the measurement (e.g., SOP-QC-1234, USP Method 621).']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., Celsius, bar, pH units, RPM, L/min, %RH). Critical for interpretation and compliance.']
  upper_control_limit decimal(18,6) [note: 'Upper acceptable limit for the parameter as defined in the master batch record or process specification. Used for pass/fail evaluation.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of the measurement verification by a supervisor or quality assurance: Pending (awaiting review), Verified (approved), Rejected (invalid), Under Review (investigation in progress).']
  verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the measurement was verified or approved by a supervisor or quality assurance personnel.']

  Note: 'Actual measured values of critical process parameters (CPPs), non-critical process parameters, and in-process control (IPC) results recorded during batch manufacturing execution. Captured from MES, PAT instruments, SCADA systems, or manual entry in the electronic batch record. Captures batch reference, process step, parameter name, parameter type (CPP, non-critical, IPC), measured value, unit of measure, measurement timestamp, measurement method, instrument ID, operator ID, pass/fail evaluation against specification limits defined in the master batch record, deviation flag, and PAT indicator. This entity is the sole SSOT for all in-process parameter measurements — parameter specifications (targets, control limits, acceptance criteria) are owned by master_batch_record while this entity owns all actuals. Provides the complete CPP/CQA data trail for each batch, supporting QbD principles, process validation (Stage 2/3), continued process verification (CPV) trending, statistical process control, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 and 21 CFR 211.188.'
}

  regulatory_report_date date [note: 'Date when the deviation was reported to regulatory authorities, if applicable.']
  regulatory_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the deviation must be reported to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, etc.) based on severity, product impact, or compliance requirements.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the identified root cause after investigation (e.g., human error, equipment failure, material defect, procedure inadequacy, environmental control failure).']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the root cause identified through investigation, including contributing factors and evidence supporting the conclusion.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Impact classification of the deviation: critical (direct impact on product quality, safety, or efficacy), major (potential impact requiring investigation), minor (no expected impact on product quality).']

  Note: 'Records unplanned departures from approved manufacturing procedures, specifications, or batch records during production. Captures deviation number, batch reference, deviation type (process, equipment, material, environmental, documentation), description, severity (critical, major, minor), detection date, detection phase (in-process, packaging, QC testing), root cause category, immediate containment actions, impact assessment, CAPA reference, closure date, and regulatory reportability flag. Integrates with MasterControl/TrackWise QMS. Distinct from quality CAPA records owned by the quality domain.'
}

  cqa_monitored varchar [note: 'List of Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) monitored during the validation study.   design_space_defined boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a design space was defined as part of the validation. True if design space was established through QbD approach.']
  deviation_count varchar [note: 'Number of deviations from the validation protocol that occurred during execution. Deviations must be documented, investigated, and assessed for impact on validation outcome per cGMP requirements.']

  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the validation.   number_of_runs varchar [note: 'Number of validation batches or runs executed as part of the validation study. Typically minimum 3 consecutive successful batches for process validation per FDA guidance. May vary based on validation type and risk assessment.']
  oos_count varchar [note: 'Number of Out of Specification (OOS) results encountered during validation execution. OOS results require investigation per FDA OOS guidance and may impact validation outcome.']
  pat_implementation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools were implemented as part of the validation. PAT is a system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through timely measurements of critical quality and performance attributes with the goal of ensuring final product quality. True if PAT tools (e.g., NIR, Raman, in-line sensors) were used.']
  process_step varchar [note: 'Specific manufacturing process step or unit operation being validated (e.g., API synthesis, granulation, blending, compression, coating, fill-finish, lyophilization, sterilization, packaging). For cleaning validation, this is the equipment or system being cleaned. For CSV, this is the computerized system being validated.']
  protocol_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the validation protocol was approved by Quality Assurance and authorized for execution. Represents the start of the validation lifecycle.']
  protocol_number varchar [note: 'Unique protocol number assigned to the validation study. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this validation activity.']
  qa_approver varchar [note: 'Name of the Quality Assurance representative who reviewed and approved the validation protocol and report. QA approval is required per cGMP regulations.']
  regulatory_filing_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the regulatory filing (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD section) where this validation data is or will be submitted. Validation data is typically included in Module 3 (Quality) of the Common Technical Document (CTD).']
  report_approval_date date [note: 'Date when the validation report was reviewed and approved by Quality Assurance. This is the official validation completion date and triggers the validated state for the process.']
  revalidation_trigger varchar [note: 'Event or condition that triggered the need for revalidation. Examples include: process changes, equipment changes, facility changes, raw material supplier changes, scale-up or scale-down, transfer to new site, out-of-specification results, quality issues, regulatory inspection findings, or periodic review schedule. Supports change control and lifecycle management per ICH Q12.']
  validation_approach varchar [note: 'Validation approach methodology. Traditional approach uses fixed process parameters and extensive testing. Quality by Design (QbD) approach uses design space and process understanding per ICH Q8. Hybrid combines traditional and QbD elements. Risk-based approach uses ICH Q9 risk management principles to focus validation efforts.']
  validation_lead varchar [note: 'Name of the person responsible for leading the validation study. Typically a validation engineer, process engineer, or quality assurance specialist.']
  validation_outcome varchar [note: 'Overall outcome of the validation study. Pass indicates all acceptance criteria were met. Fail indicates one or more acceptance criteria were not met. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations that require corrective action but do not invalidate the study. Inconclusive indicates validation could not be completed or results were ambiguous.']
  validation_stage varchar [note: 'Stage of process validation per FDA lifecycle approach. Stage 1 (Process Design) establishes commercial manufacturing process based on development knowledge. Stage 2 (Process Qualification) confirms process design is capable of reproducible commercial manufacturing. Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification) provides ongoing assurance that process remains in control. Also includes legacy approaches: prospective (validation before routine production), concurrent (validation during routine production), and retrospective (validation using historical data).']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the validation study. Draft indicates protocol is being prepared. In Progress indicates validation execution is underway. Under Review indicates validation report is being reviewed by Quality Assurance. Approved indicates validation successfully completed and approved. Rejected indicates validation failed to meet acceptance criteria. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations requiring follow-up. Expired indicates validation has exceeded its periodic review date and requires revalidation. Superseded indicates validation has been replaced by a newer study. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|under_review|approved|rejected|conditional|expired|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  validation_type varchar [note: 'Type of validation being performed. Process validation covers manufacturing processes, cleaning validation covers equipment cleaning procedures, computerized system validation covers MES/SCADA/LIMS systems per 21 CFR Part 11, analytical method validation covers laboratory test methods, equipment validation covers production equipment qualification, and sterilization validation covers sterilization cycles.']

  Note: 'Records of process validation studies conducted to demonstrate that a manufacturing process consistently produces a product meeting its predetermined specifications and quality attributes, per FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011) and ICH Q8/Q10. Covers all validation types including process validation (Stages 1-3), cleaning validation (dirty hold time, clean hold time, swab/rinse recovery), and computer system validation (CSV/CSA for MES, SCADA, LIMS). Captures validation protocol number, product, process step or system, validation stage (Stage 1 prospective, Stage 2 process qualification, Stage 3 continued process verification), validation type (process, cleaning, computerized system, analytical method transfer), number of validation batches or runs, acceptance criteria, validation outcome (pass/fail/conditional), approval date, revalidation triggers, and next periodic review date. Supports lifecycle approach to validation per ICH Q12.'
}

  monitoring_location_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the monitoring location (e.g., \'Near filling line conveyor belt, 1 meter from HEPA filter\').']
  monitoring_type varchar [note: 'Type of environmental monitoring performed: viable air (microbial air sampling), surface (contact plates or swabs), personnel (gown or glove sampling), non-viable particulate (particle counting), or water (for water systems).']
  organism_identified varchar [note: 'Name of the microorganism identified in the sample (e.g., Staphylococcus epidermidis, Bacillus species). Null if no growth or if identification not performed.']
  particulate_count_0_5_micron varchar [note: 'Number of particles equal to or greater than 0.5 microns detected per cubic meter for non-viable particulate monitoring.']
  particulate_count_5_0_micron varchar [note: 'Number of particles equal to or greater than 5.0 microns detected per cubic meter for non-viable particulate monitoring.']

  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this environmental monitoring record was last updated in the system.']
  result_status varchar [note: 'Status of the environmental monitoring result: pass (within limits), alert (exceeded alert limit), action (exceeded action limit), or fail (critical excursion).']
  review_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the environmental monitoring result was reviewed and approved by quality assurance.']
  sample_collection_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the environmental monitoring sample was collected.']
  sample_volume_liters decimal(10,2) [note: 'Volume of air sampled in liters for viable or non-viable air monitoring. Null for surface or personnel monitoring.']
  sampling_method varchar [note: 'Specific method used to collect the environmental sample (e.g., active air sampling with impactor, passive settle plate, contact plate, swab, finger dab, glove print).']
  trend_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this result is part of an adverse trend requiring investigation (True) or not (False).']

  Note: 'Records of environmental monitoring (EM) results for cleanrooms and controlled manufacturing areas, capturing microbial and particulate data as required under cGMP for sterile and non-sterile manufacturing. Captures monitoring location, cleanroom classification (ISO 5/6/7/8, Grade A/B/C/D), monitoring type (viable air, surface, personnel, non-viable particulate), sample date/time, organism identified, colony forming units (CFU), action limit, alert limit, pass/fail status, and trend flag. Supports contamination control strategy per Annex 1 (EMA) and 21 CFR 211.42.'
}

Table manufacturing.investigational_product_supply {
  investigational_product_supply_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this investigational product supply allocation record. Primary key.']
  investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the clinical trial investigator receiving investigational product manufactured according to this master batch record.']
  master_batch_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the master batch record that defines the manufacturing specification for the investigational product supplied to this investigator.']
  approved_indication varchar [note: 'The specific therapeutic indication or disease state for which this MBR-investigator supply allocation is approved. An investigator may receive different MBRs for different indications across multiple trials.']
  created_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this investigational product supply allocation record was created in the system.']
  dosing_regimen varchar [note: 'The approved dosing regimen for this specific MBR-investigator combination, including frequency, route of administration, and duration. Varies by trial protocol and investigator site.']
  last_modified_date timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this investigational product supply allocation record was last modified.']
  protocol_number varchar [note: 'The clinical trial protocol number under which this investigational product supply is provided. Links supply allocation to specific trial regulatory documentation.']
  regulatory_approval_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the regulatory approval (IND, CTA, or equivalent) under which this specific MBR-investigator supply is authorized. Required for regulatory traceability.']
  supply_allocation_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'The quantity of investigational product (manufactured per this MBR) allocated to this investigator for this trial. Measured in units consistent with the MBR batch size UOM.']
  supply_end_date date [note: 'The date when investigational product supply from this MBR to this investigator ended or is planned to end. Used for supply chain planning and batch reconciliation.']
  supply_start_date date [note: 'The date when investigational product supply from this MBR to this investigator began. Critical for regulatory traceability and shelf-life management.']
  supply_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this investigational product supply allocation. Tracks lifecycle from planning through completion or cancellation.']
  trial_phase varchar [note: 'The clinical trial phase for which this investigational product supply is allocated. Different phases may use different formulations or strengths from different MBRs.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the supply allocation and usage tracking between master batch records (manufacturing specifications for investigational products) and clinical trial investigators. It captures trial-specific supply chain planning, dosing regimens, approved indications, and regulatory traceability requirements per ICH GMP Annex 13. Each record links one master batch record to one investigator with attributes that exist only in the context of this clinical supply relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical clinical operations, a single master batch record (manufacturing specification) is used to produce investigational product that is supplied to multiple investigators across different trials, phases, and sites. Conversely, each investigator typically receives investigational product from multiple master batch records representing different formulations, strengths, or product variants across their portfolio of trials. The business actively manages these supply allocations as distinct operational records with trial-specific attributes.'
}

  robustness_result varchar [note: 'Outcome of the robustness assessment. Pass indicates the method is robust to deliberate variations in parameters such as pH, temperature, flow rate, or mobile phase composition.']
  specificity_result varchar [note: 'Outcome of the specificity assessment. Pass indicates the method can unequivocally assess the analyte in the presence of impurities, degradation products, and matrix components.']
  technique varchar [note: 'Analytical technique or instrumentation used (e.g., HPLC, GC, UV-Vis Spectroscopy, FTIR, Mass Spectrometry, Titration, Dissolution Apparatus).']
  validation_completion_date date [note: 'Date when all validation activities were completed and the method was deemed validated.']
  validation_protocol_number varchar [note: 'Unique protocol number assigned to the method validation study. Business identifier for the validation activity.']
  validation_report_number varchar [note: 'Unique document number for the final validation report summarizing all validation activities and results.']
  validation_start_date date [note: 'Date when the method validation activities commenced.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the method validation activity. Tracks progression from draft through approval or rejection.']
  validation_type varchar [note: 'Type of validation performed: full validation for new methods, partial for minor modifications, revalidation for significant changes, cross-validation for method transfer, or concurrent validation during routine use.']

  Note: 'Analytical method validation records demonstrating that a test method is fit for its intended purpose per ICH Q2(R1). Captures method type (assay, identification, impurity, dissolution), validation parameters assessed (specificity, linearity, accuracy, precision, LOD, LOQ, robustness), validation protocol number, validation report reference, regulatory submission inclusion flag, method transfer status, and compendial method flag. Sourced from LIMS and Veeva Vault.'
}

  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the validation protocol: draft (under development), approved (ready for execution), in_execution (testing underway), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (successfully finished), failed (did not meet acceptance criteria), conditional_pass (passed with minor observations), or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|in_execution|on_hold|completed|failed|conditional_pass|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  validation_type varchar [note: 'Type of validation being performed: IQ (Installation Qualification), OQ (Operational Qualification), PQ (Performance Qualification), process validation stages 1-3, cleaning validation, CSV (Computer System Validation) per 21 CFR Part 11, concurrent validation, retrospective validation, or CPV (Continued Process Verification). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IQ|OQ|PQ|process_stage_1|process_stage_2|process_stage_3|cleaning|CSV|concurrent|retrospective|CPV — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  review_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the product quality review type. Annual reviews are standard ICH Q10 requirement; interim reviews may be triggered by significant events; ad-hoc reviews address specific quality concerns.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system from which this product quality review record originated (e.g., MasterControl, TrackWise, SAP QM, Veeva Vault QualityDocs).']
  stability_failure_count varchar [note: 'Number of stability failures or out-of-specification stability results observed during the review period. Critical indicator of product shelf-life integrity.']
  stability_study_count varchar [note: 'Number of ongoing stability studies for this product during the review period. Includes registration, commercial, and supporting stability protocols.']
  strength varchar [note: 'Strength or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the finished dosage form, including unit of measure (e.g., 50mg, 100mg/mL).']

  total_batches_rejected varchar [note: 'Total number of batches rejected during the review period due to quality failures, out-of-specification results, or GMP deviations. Key indicator of manufacturing process capability.']
  total_batches_released varchar [note: 'Total number of batches released for distribution during the review period. Indicates successful completion of quality control testing and Quality Person (QP) certification.']

  Note: 'Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) / Product Quality Review (PQR) records aggregating quality performance data for each marketed product on an annual cycle as required by ICH Q10, EU GMP Chapter 1, and 21 CFR 211.180(e). Captures review period, product scope, batch analysis summary, deviation/CAPA/OOS trends, stability trending, change control summary, complaint trends, recall history, process capability metrics, revalidation needs, management review conclusions, and approved action items. Serves as the primary input to management review and continual improvement decisions.'

The vendor_site product already contains site_name and location details.]']

  site_response_submitted_date date [note: 'Actual date when the vendor site submitted formal responses to audit findings']

  Note: 'This association product represents the inspection event between audit and vendor_site. It captures the specific audit activities conducted at each vendor site, including audit outcomes, findings classification, CAPA requirements, and follow-up schedules. Each record links one audit to one vendor site with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific site inspection within a broader audit program.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical supplier quality management, a single audit program can encompass multiple vendor sites (e.g., a CMO with manufacturing facilities in three countries), and each vendor site undergoes multiple audits over time (initial qualification, annual surveillance, for-cause investigations, pre-approval inspections). The business actively manages each audit-site inspection as a distinct quality event with its own findings, CAPA requirements, and follow-up schedules.'

  capacity_constraint_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this supply plan record is constrained by manufacturing capacity limitations (True) or represents an unconstrained theoretical plan (False). Distinguishes constrained from unconstrained plan scenarios.']
  capacity_utilization_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of available manufacturing capacity consumed by this supply plan at the designated manufacturing site. Used for capacity management, bottleneck identification, and CMO contract utilization tracking.']
  cold_chain_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the planned material requires cold-chain storage and transportation (True) to maintain product integrity. Triggers cold-chain logistics requirements in GDP-compliant distribution planning.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the supply plan record was first created in the source planning system (Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, or SAP PP). Part of the audit trail for plan lifecycle tracking.']
  gdp_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the supply plan has been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements for the planned distribution lanes and storage conditions.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the supply plan record was most recently modified in the source planning system. Supports change tracking, plan versioning, and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  lead_time_days varchar [note: 'Total planned lead time in calendar days from production start (or purchase order placement) to material availability at the destination site. Includes manufacturing, QC release, and logistics transit time. Used for MRP scheduling.']
  material_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the pharmaceutical material covered by this supply plan: Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP), Finished Dosage Form (FDF), Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, or packaging component. Aligns with CMC categorization.']
  ndc_code varchar [note: 'National Drug Code assigned by the FDA uniquely identifying the drug product, labeler, and package size. Required for US commercial supply planning and distribution. Applicable to FDF and DP material types.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for supply planners to document assumptions, constraints, risk factors, or exceptions associated with this supply plan record. Supports S&OP decision documentation and audit trail.']
  number_of_batches varchar [note: 'Total number of manufacturing batches planned within the planning horizon for this supply plan record. Used for capacity loading, CMO scheduling, and GMP batch record planning.']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the supply plan, sourced from Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, or SAP PP (e.g., SP-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability and communication with CMOs/CDMOs.']
  plan_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the supply plan. Draft indicates work-in-progress; approved indicates sign-off by supply chain leadership; frozen indicates locked for execution; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; cancelled indicates plan is void.']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the supply plan indicating whether it reflects capacity and material constraints (constrained) or theoretical demand without constraints (unconstrained). Consensus plan represents the agreed S&OP output. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: constrained|unconstrained|consensus|rough_cut|master — promote to reference product]']
  planned_production_qty decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total planned production or procurement quantity for the material within the planning horizon, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., kg for DS/API, units for FDF/DP). Core quantitative output of the supply plan.']
  planned_production_start_date date [note: 'The scheduled start date for the manufacturing or procurement activity. Used for capacity planning, CMO scheduling, and lead time management. Derived from planned receipt date minus production lead time.']
  planned_receipt_date date [note: 'The date on which the planned quantity is expected to be received at the destination site or made available in inventory. Used for inventory availability calculations and demand fulfillment scheduling.']
  planning_cycle varchar [note: 'Identifier for the S&OP or supply planning cycle in which this plan was generated (e.g., \'2024-Q3-Cycle2\', \'Monthly-2024-09\'). Enables tracking of plan evolution across planning cycles and version comparison.']
  planning_horizon_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the latest date for which planned production or receipt quantities are captured. Typically 12–36 months for pharmaceutical supply planning.']
  planning_horizon_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the earliest date for which planned production or receipt quantities are captured. Typically aligned with the S&OP cycle.']
  quantity_uom varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the planned production quantity (e.g., kg for drug substance, units/vials/tablets for finished dosage forms). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|units|vials|tablets|capsules|batches — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  reorder_point_qty decimal(18,4) [note: 'Inventory level at which a replenishment order is triggered for the material at the destination site. Used in SAP MM MRP reorder point planning to ensure continuous supply availability.']
  safety_stock_qty decimal(18,4) [note: 'Planned safety stock quantity for the material at the destination site, expressed in the quantity UOM. Represents the buffer inventory maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Configured in SAP MM MRP.']
  scenario varchar [note: 'Scenario classification for the supply plan, supporting what-if analysis and risk planning. Base is the primary plan; optimistic and pessimistic reflect demand upside/downside; risk_adjusted incorporates supply risk mitigations.']
  shelf_life_days varchar [note: 'Remaining shelf life in calendar days for the planned material at the time of planned receipt. Critical for pharmaceutical supply planning to ensure product reaches patients with adequate remaining shelf life per GDP and customer requirements.']
  sku_code varchar [note: 'Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific saleable or transferable unit of the drug product or FDF. Used for commercial inventory management and distribution planning. Aligns with SAP MM material number.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage temperature condition for the planned material (e.g., ambient 15-25°C, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, ultra-frozen -80°C). Drives cold-chain logistics and warehouse configuration requirements.']
  supply_chain_segment varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the supply plan pertains to the commercial supply chain or the clinical trial supply chain. Clinical supply plans are subject to IND/CTA requirements and GCP; commercial plans are subject to GMP and GDP.']
  supply_type varchar [note: 'Indicates the sourcing strategy for the planned supply: make (internal manufacturing), buy (external procurement from CMO/CDMO), or transfer (inter-site or inter-company stock transfer). Drives MRP logic in SAP PP and Kinaxis.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports plan versioning and comparison between constrained and unconstrained scenarios across planning cycles.']

  Note: 'Constrained and unconstrained supply plan for drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and finished dosage form (FDF) across manufacturing sites and CMOs/CDMOs. Captures planned production quantities, planned receipt dates, supply source, planning horizon, capacity constraints, and plan version. Integrates with Kinaxis RapidResponse/Blue Yonder and SAP PP. Tracks plan status (draft, approved, frozen) and supply type (make, buy, transfer).'
}

Provides the precise audit timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and GMP batch record documentation. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the material cost amount (WAERS in SAP). Represents the local currency of the issuing plant. Required for multi-currency financial consolidation and cross-border supply chain cost reporting.']
  destruction_certificate_number varchar [note: 'The certificate of destruction document number issued by a licensed waste disposal or pharmaceutical destruction contractor when materials are scrapped or destroyed (movement type 551/552). Required for GMP compliance, DEA controlled substance destruction reporting, and environmental regulatory compliance. Populated only for destruction goods issues.']
  document_date date [note: 'The date the goods issue document was physically created or the actual date of the material movement (BLDAT in SAP). May differ from posting_date when backdated postings occur. Used for audit trail and GMP documentation compliance.']
  gi_document_number varchar [note: 'The externally-known SAP material document number assigned to the goods issue posting (e.g., 4900012345). This is the primary business identifier referenced in GMP batch records, cost accounting entries, and supply chain traceability. Corresponds to MBLNR in SAP MSEG/MKPF tables.']
  gi_document_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year in which the goods issue material document was posted in SAP (MJAHR). Required in combination with gi_document_number to uniquely identify a material document in SAP MM.']
  gi_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the goods issue document. \'posted\' indicates the GI is active and inventory has been reduced; \'reversed\' indicates a reversal document has been posted (movement type 262/552/602); \'blocked\' indicates the document is on quality hold; \'cancelled\' indicates the document was voided prior to posting.']
  is_controlled_substance boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the issued material is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring additional regulatory documentation, DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic ordering, and controlled substance inventory reconciliation. When True, the goods issue must comply with DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 record-keeping requirements.']
  is_gmp_relevant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this goods issue is subject to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation and traceability requirements. True for materials used in GMP-regulated manufacturing, clinical trial supply, or quality testing. False for non-GMP materials such as office supplies, maintenance items, or non-regulated consumables. Drives GMP batch record inclusion and regulatory audit scope.']
  issued_quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'The quantity of material issued in the base unit of measure (ERFMG in SAP MSEG). Represents the actual amount consumed, shipped, scrapped, or transferred.   issuing_storage_location varchar [note: 'The SAP storage location (LGORT) from which the material is physically withdrawn.   last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the goods issue record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer.   material_cost_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total cost value of the goods issue calculated as issued_quantity multiplied by the material valuation price at time of posting (DMBTR in SAP MSEG in local currency).   movement_type varchar [note: 'SAP MM movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods issue (BWART in MSEG). Key values: 261=Goods issue to production order (consumption), 551=Scrapping/destruction, 601=Goods issue for delivery/customer shipment, 311=Transfer posting within plant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 261|262|551|552|601|602|311|312|901|902 — promote to reference product]']
  movement_type_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the SAP movement type (e.g., \'Goods Issue to Production Order\', \'Goods Issue for Delivery\', \'Scrapping\', \'Sample Withdrawal\', \'Transfer Posting\').   order_reference_number varchar [note: 'The reference number of the consuming or receiving order associated with the goods issue. For production consumption (movement type 261), this is the SAP production order number (AUFNR). For clinical supply, this is the clinical trial supply order number. For customer delivery, this is the SAP sales order number (VBELN). Central to GMP batch record traceability and cost allocation.']
  order_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the order type associated with the goods issue. Determines the business process context: production_order/process_order for manufacturing consumption, sales_order for commercial customer delivery, clinical_supply_order for investigational product distribution to trial sites, transfer_order for inter-plant movements, destruction_order for controlled substance or expired material disposal.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The accounting and inventory posting date of the goods issue (BUDAT in SAP). Determines the period in which inventory reduction and cost accounting entries are recorded. Critical for period-end closing, GMP batch record dating, and regulatory traceability.']
  profit_center varchar [note: 'The SAP profit center (PRCTR) associated with the goods issue for management accounting and P&L reporting. Enables attribution of material costs to specific business units, therapeutic areas, or product lines. Supports segment reporting and profitability analysis per IFRS 8.']
  reason_code varchar [note: 'The SAP reason code (GRUND) providing additional classification for the goods issue movement, particularly for scrapping, destruction, or non-standard consumption. Examples include: expired material destruction, quality rejection scrap, clinical trial sample, regulatory submission sample, stability testing sample.   receiving_storage_location varchar [note: 'For intra-plant transfer postings (movement type 311), the destination storage location within the same plant. Tracks material movement between warehouse zones, e.g., from quarantine to released stock, from bulk storage to dispensing area, or from cold-chain to ambient staging.']
  reference_document_number varchar [note: 'External or cross-system reference document number associated with the goods issue (XBLNR in SAP).   reversal_document_number varchar [note: 'The SAP material document number of the reversal posting (STBLG) if this goods issue has been reversed.   special_stock_indicator varchar [note: 'SAP special stock indicator (SOBKZ) identifying whether the issued material belongs to a special stock category. Key values: E=Sales order stock (customer-specific), Q=Project stock, K=Consignment stock at customer, W=Vendor consignment stock. Empty value indicates standard own stock. Critical for clinical trial supply (project stock) and consignment management.']
  stock_type varchar [note: 'The quality/availability stock type from which the material was issued (INSMK in SAP). Indicates whether material was issued from unrestricted (released) stock, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, or restricted-use stock. Critical for GMP compliance — goods issues from quality inspection or blocked stock require QA authorization and deviation documentation.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The base unit of measure for the issued quantity (ERFME in SAP MSEG). Standard pharmaceutical units include KG (kilograms) for APIs and bulk materials, ML/L for liquids, EA (each) for finished units, TAB/CAP for solid dosage forms, VIAL/AMP for injectables. Aligns with SAP UoM configuration and GMP batch record documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|G|MG|L|ML|EA|BT|BX|PAL|TAB|CAP|VIAL|AMP — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  valuation_type varchar [note: 'The inventory valuation method applied to the goods issue for cost accounting purposes (BWTAR in SAP). Impacts COGS calculation and financial reporting accuracy.']

  Note: 'Record of material consumption or outbound movement from inventory including issuance to production orders, clinical trial supply kits, sample distribution, destruction, quality testing, or customer delivery. }

Direct link enables traceability from inspection observation to recall initiation, supports regulatory resp']
  responsible_person_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Recalls require documented responsible person for regulatory traceability, CAPA ownership, and health authority reporting. New attribute needed; removes denormalized responsible_person text field.']
  site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the manufacturing site where the affected lots were produced. Enables traceability back to the production facility for root cause investigation and regulatory inspection purposes.']
  affected_markets varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of ISO 3-letter country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU) identifying the countries or markets where the recalled product was distributed and where recall actions must be executed.']
  cold_chain_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the recalled product requires cold-chain handling (temperature-controlled logistics) during the recovery and return process. Critical for biologics, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive drug products.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the product recall record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and data lineage tracking.']
  customer_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which direct customers (wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, pharmacies) were formally notified of the recall via recall notification letters or electronic communications.']
  customer_notification_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the customer notification process indicating whether recall notification letters have been sent to all affected customers in the distribution chain.']
  distribution_level varchar [note: 'The level in the distribution chain to which the recall extends. Consumer: product reached end patients/consumers; Retail: product at retail pharmacy level; Wholesale: product at wholesale distributor level; Hospital: product at hospital/clinic level; User: product at healthcare professional level.']
  effectiveness_check_level varchar [note: 'FDA-defined effectiveness check level indicating the depth and percentage of consignees to be audited to verify recall notification receipt and product return. Level A: 100% of consignees; Level B: some percentage; Level C: 10% of consignees; Level D: 2% of consignees; Not Required: for certain recall types.']
  expiration_date_range varchar [note: 'The expiration date range (e.g., \'2024-01 to 2025-06\') covering all affected lot numbers included in the recall. Assists customers and distributors in identifying recalled product on shelves and in inventory.']
  gdp_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the recall execution is being conducted in compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) guidelines, including proper documentation, chain of custody, and temperature-controlled handling of recovered product where applicable.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|Company — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  ndc_code varchar [note: 'The National Drug Code (NDC) of the affected drug product in the standard 5-4-2 format. Uniquely identifies the labeler, product, and package configuration of the recalled pharmaceutical product as registered with the FDA.']
