  enrollment_date date [note: 'Date when the medicinal product was formally enrolled in this registry for monitoring and data collection. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  enrollment_end_date date [note: 'Date when enrollment of this medicinal product in this registry was completed or terminated. Null if enrollment is still active.']
  enrollment_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the product enrollment in this registry. Active: data collection ongoing; Suspended: temporarily paused; Completed: all required data collected; Terminated: enrollment ended prematurely. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this registry enrollment record was last modified.']
  outcome_status varchar [note: 'Summary status of clinical or safety outcomes observed for this product within this registry. Tracks aggregate outcome data at the product-registry level. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  primary_indication varchar [note: 'The specific disease indication or therapeutic use for which this medicinal product is being monitored within this registry. A product may be enrolled for different indications across multiple registries. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  protocol_amendment_number varchar [note: 'Specific protocol amendment number under which this product was enrolled, if the enrollment occurred after the initial protocol version.']
  target_patient_count varchar [note: 'Target number of patients to be enrolled for this specific medicinal product within this registry, as specified in the protocol or regulatory commitment.']
  treatment_line varchar [note: 'The line of therapy context in which this medicinal product is being used and monitored within the registry (e.g., first-line, second-line, maintenance therapy). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the enrollment of a medicinal product in a patient registry for post-marketing surveillance, safety monitoring, or regulatory commitment fulfillment. It captures product-specific enrollment data including enrollment dates, treatment context, and outcome tracking. Each record links one medicinal product to one registry with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific product-registry enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical operations, medicinal products are enrolled in multiple patient registries simultaneously (e.g., a checkpoint inhibitor may be tracked in an oncology disease registry, a pregnancy exposure registry, and a REMS-mandated safety registry). Conversely, each registry monitors multiple medicinal products within its therapeutic scope (e.g., a rare disease registry tracks all approved therapies for that condition). Registry enrollment is an operational business process managed by pharmacovigilance and regulatory affairs teams, with specific enrollment dates, data collection protocols, and outcome tracking for each product-registry combination.'
}

Table commercial.hcp_target {
  hcp_target_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the HCP targeting and call planning record within the commercial segmentation and planning layer.']
  brand_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the pharmaceutical brand or product for which this HCP is being targeted. Supports brand-level P&L reporting and promotional resource allocation.']
  cycle_plan_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the targeting/planning cycle (e.g., Q1 2025 cycle plan) under which this HCP target record was created. A cycle plan defines the planning period and field force objectives.']
  market_formulary_position_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to market.formulary_position. Business justification: HCP targeting considers formulary position to prioritize physicians where brand has favorable access. Targeting strategy and resource allocation process links targets to formulary status for call plan']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the HCP master record (owned by the hcp domain) that is being targeted. This is the commercial segmentation layer — the HCP master itself is managed separately.']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: HCP targeting strategies are product-specific. Call planning, territory design, and prescriber segmentation require product linkage. Real business process: targeting cycle planning and call plan optim']
  msl_engagement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to medical.msl_engagement. Business justification: Commercial targeting decisions informed by most recent MSL scientific engagement with same HCP. Enables coordinated field strategy, prevents engagement conflicts, and supports KOL tier assignment base']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to clinical.principal_investigator. Business justification: Commercial targeting identifies KOLs who are clinical investigators. Enables coordinated engagement strategy, speaker recruitment from trial sites, advisory board selection, and transparency reporting']
  sales_rep_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the sales representative (field force employee) assigned to engage this HCP target within the territory for the planning cycle.']
  territory_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the sales territory to which this HCP target is assigned for the planning cycle. Drives field force routing and call planning in Veeva CRM.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Workflow approval status of the targeting plan record. Tracks whether the target assignment has been reviewed and approved by the regional or national sales manager before field force execution.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the sales manager or commercial operations approver who authorized this HCP target plan record. Supports audit trail and compliance review.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date on which the targeting plan record was formally approved by the authorized sales manager or commercial operations team. Marks the transition from planning to execution.']
  call_type_mix_pct_f2f decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of total planned calls that are designated as face-to-face interactions (0.00–100.00). Used to monitor adherence to brand-level call mix strategy and field force deployment guidelines.']
  competitor_prescriber boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HCP is known to prescribe a competing product in the same therapeutic class. Used to prioritize conversion-focused engagement strategies and messaging.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this HCP target record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.']
  current_brand_prescriber boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HCP is currently an active prescriber of the targeted brand based on the most recent prescribing data. Distinguishes new-to-brand targets from existing prescribers for tailored engagement strategies.']
  cycle_call_count varchar [note: 'Number of completed sales calls made to this HCP for the targeted brand within the current cycle plan period. Used to measure in-cycle execution progress against planned_call_frequency.']
  do_not_contact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates that this HCP has requested no promotional contact or has been placed on a do-not-contact list. When true, field force must not initiate promotional calls. Critical for compliance with HCP opt-out preferences and applicable privacy regulations.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this HCP target assignment expires or is no longer active. Nullable for open-ended targeting. Defines the end of the targeting period for the cycle.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this HCP target assignment is active and the field force is authorized to engage the HCP for the specified brand and territory. Defines the start of the targeting period.']
  engagement_channel_preference varchar [note: 'HCP\'s preferred channel for sales representative engagement as captured in Veeva CRM or Salesforce Health Cloud. Informs call type mix planning and omnichannel engagement strategy.']
  is_kol boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this HCP is designated as a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) for the targeted brand or therapeutic area. KOL status influences engagement strategy, speaker program eligibility, and medical affairs coordination.']
  is_sample_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this HCP is eligible to receive drug samples for the targeted brand. Governed by the Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA) and internal sample distribution policies.']
  is_speaker_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this HCP is eligible to participate in brand speaker programs. Eligibility is governed by PhRMA Code compliance, Sunshine Act reporting requirements, and internal speaker bureau criteria.']
  last_detail_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent promotional detail (sales call) made to this HCP for the targeted brand. Used to monitor call recency, identify lapsed targets, and prioritize field force scheduling.']
  market_potential_segment varchar [note: 'Categorical assessment of the HCP\'s overall market potential for the brand, derived from prescribing volume, patient panel size, and payer mix. Used alongside prescribing_potential_decile for targeting decisions.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this HCP target record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  planned_call_frequency varchar [note: 'Target number of sales calls (details) planned for this HCP during the cycle plan period. Drives field force scheduling and activity quotas in Veeva CRM.']
  planned_f2f_calls varchar [note: 'Number of planned in-person (face-to-face) sales calls for this HCP within the cycle. Part of the call type mix alongside remote calls. Supports field force activity planning and compliance with call mix targets.']
  planned_remote_calls varchar [note: 'Number of planned remote (virtual/telephone) sales calls for this HCP within the cycle. Complements planned_f2f_calls to define the full call type mix for the planning period.']
  prescribing_potential_decile varchar [note: 'Decile ranking (1–10) of the HCP\'s estimated prescribing potential for the targeted brand\'s therapeutic area, derived from claims data or market research. Decile 10 = highest prescribing potential. Key input to target tier assignment.']
  priority_rank varchar [note: 'Numeric rank of this HCP target within the territory for the given brand and cycle plan. Lower rank = higher priority. Used to sequence call planning when field force capacity is constrained.']
  specialty_segment varchar [note: 'Medical specialty segment of the HCP as used for commercial targeting purposes (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Immunology, Primary Care). May differ from the HCP master specialty if the brand targets a sub-specialty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|cardiology|immunology|primary_care|neurology|endocrinology|rheumatology|hematology|gastroenterology|pulmonology — promote to reference product]']
  sunshine_act_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether interactions and transfers of value with this HCP target are subject to mandatory reporting under the U.S. Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments). Drives downstream aggregation for CMS Open Payments reporting.']
  target_record_number varchar [note: 'Business-facing unique identifier for this HCP target record, used in Veeva CRM and downstream reporting. Distinct from the surrogate hcp_target_id.']
  target_tier varchar [note: 'Segmentation tier assigned to the HCP for this brand and cycle, reflecting strategic priority for field force engagement. Tier A = highest priority, Tier D = lowest. Drives call frequency and resource allocation.']
  targeting_rationale varchar [note: 'Free-text or structured justification for why this HCP has been selected and tiered for this brand and cycle. May reference prescribing behavior, patient population, KOL status, or market development opportunity.']
  targeting_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this HCP target record within the planning cycle. Active = currently targeted; Inactive = de-prioritized; Pending = awaiting approval; Suspended = temporarily paused; Removed = excluded from targeting.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area associated with the targeted brand (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Used for cross-brand analytics, field force alignment, and brand P&L reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neuroscience|infectious_disease|endocrinology|hematology — promote to reference product]']
  veeva_crm_record_code varchar [note: 'Source system record identifier from Veeva CRM corresponding to this HCP target record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the Veeva CRM operational system.']
  ytd_call_count varchar [note: 'Number of completed sales calls (details) made to this HCP for the targeted brand in the current year-to-date period. Tracks field force execution against planned call frequency targets.']

  Note: 'Commercial targeting and call planning record linking an HCP (owned by the hcp domain) to a brand, territory, and sales rep for a given targeting/planning cycle. Captures target tier (A/B/C), planned call frequency, call type mix (face-to-face vs. remote), specialty segment, prescribing potential decile, targeting rationale, priority rank, effective period, plan approval status, and targeting status. Drives field force activity scheduling, call planning, and promotional resource allocation in Veeva CRM. Distinct from the HCP master (owned by hcp domain) — this is the commercial segmentation and planning layer.'
}

Business justification: Commercial sales calls frequently trigger medical information requests that must be routed to medical affairs for compliant response. Direct operational handoff tracked for regulatory compliance and o']

Business justification: Medical science liaisons (MSLs) conduct site engagement visits for recruitment support, data dissemination, and investigator relations. Tracks commercial-clinical interface at trial sites, essential f']
  market_formulary_position_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to market.formulary_position. Business justification: Call activities capture HCP feedback on formulary access barriers (PA, step therapy). Field intelligence gathering process links call records to formulary positions for tracking access issues and info']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Healthcare Professional (HCP) who was the primary target of this detail call. Links to the HCP master record.']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Call activities detail medicinal products to HCPs. Call reporting, promotional effectiveness analysis, and reach/frequency metrics require product linkage. Real business process: call reporting and pr']
  molecular_target_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to discovery.molecular_target. Business justification: Sales reps detail mechanism of action referencing specific molecular targets during HCP calls. Required for call content tracking, medical-commercial alignment verification, promotional compliance aud']
  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Field promotional activities require PhRMA Code compliance monitoring. Links call activities to compliance oversight program for off-label discussion monitoring, sample compliance, and promotional con']
  promo_material_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary promotional material (detail aid, leave-behind, or digital asset) presented during the call, as approved in Veeva PromoMats. Supports promotional compliance auditing.']
  sales_rep_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the field sales representative (Medical Science Liaison, Sales Rep, or Key Account Manager) who conducted the call.']
  territory_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the sales territory in which this call activity occurred. Used for field force effectiveness measurement and territory performance reporting.']
  call_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the field force interaction (detail call) took place. Principal business event date used for field force effectiveness reporting and Sunshine Act transparency reporting.']
  call_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the call interaction concluded, as recorded in Veeva CRM. Used together with call_start_timestamp to derive call duration for field force effectiveness analytics.']
  call_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative entered by the sales representative summarizing the content and outcome of the interaction. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of commercially sensitive HCP engagement details.']

  call_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the call interaction began, as recorded in Veeva CRM. Used for call duration calculation and scheduling compliance.']
  call_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the call activity record within Veeva CRM workflow. \'Submitted\' indicates the rep has locked the record; \'Approved\' indicates manager sign-off has been completed.']
  call_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the interaction channel used for the detail call. Drives field force effectiveness segmentation and PhRMA code compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: face_to_face|remote_video|phone|email|congress|group_meeting|medical_education_event — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  channel_mix_code varchar [note: 'Categorizes the call within the omnichannel engagement model (field, inside sales, digital, or hybrid). Supports channel mix optimization analytics and commercial strategy reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the call activity record was first created in Veeva CRM by the sales representative. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.']
  crm_sync_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the call record was last synchronized from Veeva CRM into the Databricks Silver layer. Used for data freshness monitoring and pipeline audit.']
  detail_priority_1_product varchar [note: 'Brand name of the first-priority product detailed during the call, as recorded in Veeva CRM. Retained as a denormalized field for reporting convenience and Sunshine Act submission.']
  detail_priority_2_product varchar [note: 'Brand name of the second-priority product detailed during the call, if applicable. Supports multi-product detailing analysis and share-of-voice reporting.']
  detail_priority_3_product varchar [note: 'Brand name of the third-priority product detailed during the call, if applicable. Supports multi-product detailing analysis and share-of-voice reporting.']
  hcp_reaction varchar [note: 'Sales representative\'s assessment of the Healthcare Professional\'s reaction to the product detail during the call. Used for HCP engagement scoring and brand sentiment analytics.']
  kol_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HCP visited during this call is classified as a Key Opinion Leader (KOL). Used for KOL engagement tracking and Medical Affairs coordination.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the call activity record in Veeva CRM. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and change tracking in the Silver layer.']
  meal_cost_usd decimal(10,2) [note: 'Actual cost in US dollars of the meal or refreshment provided during the call. Used for PhRMA Code per-person meal cap compliance monitoring and Sunshine Act reporting.']
  meal_provided_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a meal or refreshment was provided to the HCP or HCO staff during this call. Required for PhRMA Code compliance and Sunshine Act transfer-of-value reporting.']
  next_best_action varchar [note: 'Recommended follow-up action for the sales representative as determined by the CRM system or rep input (e.g., schedule follow-up call, send clinical reprint, invite to speaker program). Supports field force coaching and CRM-driven engagement planning.']
  off_label_discussion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any off-label (unapproved indication) discussion occurred during the call. Classified as confidential due to regulatory sensitivity. Triggers compliance review workflow when True.']
  phrma_code_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the call activity was conducted in full compliance with the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Healthcare Professionals. Used for internal compliance monitoring and audit reporting.']
  promo_material_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the promotional material presented during the call, as tracked in Veeva PromoMats. Ensures only current, approved versions are used in the field.']
  sample_lot_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturing lot number of the drug samples distributed during the call. Required for PDMA sample accountability and product recall traceability.']
  sample_quantity varchar [note: 'Total number of drug sample units distributed to the HCP during this call. Used for PDMA sample accountability reconciliation and Sunshine Act transfer-of-value reporting.']
  samples_dropped_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether drug samples were distributed to the HCP during this call. Drives sample accountability reporting and Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA) compliance.']
  signature_captured_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HCP\'s electronic signature was captured during this call, as required for sample distribution under PDMA. A value of True confirms regulatory signature compliance.']
  speaker_program_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this call activity is associated with or resulted from a speaker program event. Links commercial call data to speaker program compliance and Sunshine Act reporting.']
  submitted_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the sales representative locked and submitted the call record in Veeva CRM, transitioning it from draft to submitted status. Key lifecycle event for field force compliance monitoring.']
  sunshine_act_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this call activity constitutes a reportable transfer of value under the Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments). Drives inclusion in the annual CMS Open Payments submission.']
  transfer_of_value_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary value in US dollars of any transfer of value (e.g., meals, samples, educational materials) provided to the HCP during this call, as required for Sunshine Act Open Payments reporting.']
  veeva_call_code varchar [note: 'Source system identifier for the call record as assigned by Veeva CRM. Used for lineage tracing and deduplication against the operational system of record.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of each field force interaction (detail call) with an HCP or HCO, sourced from Veeva CRM. Captures call date, call type (face-to-face, remote, phone), HCP/HCO visited, products detailed, samples dropped, promotional materials presented, call outcome, next best action, signature captured flag, off-label discussion flag, and PhRMA code compliance status. Core to field force effectiveness measurement and Sunshine Act reporting.'
}

Table commercial.sample_management {
  sample_management_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for sample_management']
  call_activity_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the sales call activity (HCP visit) in Veeva CRM during which this sample was disbursed. Links sample transactions to call reporting for promotional compliance and field force effectiveness analytics.']
  cogs_entry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cogs_entry. Business justification: Sample distribution represents COGS - product given away has cost impact. Required for accurate gross-to-net calculations and inventory valuation.']
  drug_product_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the pharmaceutical product (drug product / finished dosage form) associated with this sample inventory position. Links to the product master.']
  market_formulary_position_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to market.formulary_position. Business justification: Sample distribution strategies consider formulary position to prioritize sampling where access is favorable. Targeting and resource allocation process links sample transactions to formulary status for']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the Healthcare Professional (HCP) who received the sample disbursement. Required for PDMA compliance and Sunshine Act Open Payments reporting. Null for non-disbursement transactions.']
  material_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Sample inventory tracks material master records for lot traceability, expiry management, PDMA compliance, and reconciliation with manufacturing batch records. Required for sample accountability audits']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Sample inventory is managed at medicinal product level. Sample accountability, PDMA compliance, and sample utilization analysis require product linkage. Real business process: sample reconciliation an']
  sales_rep_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the sales representative who holds or is responsible for this sample inventory position. Links to the sales rep master record in Veeva CRM / Salesforce Health Cloud.']
  storage_location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: Samples must be stored in GDP-qualified locations. Required for temperature excursion investigations, sample accountability audits, PDMA compliance, and regulatory inspection readiness for sample stor']
  territory_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the sales territory to which this sample inventory position is assigned. Used for territory-level sample accountability and reconciliation reporting.']
  adjustment_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for a sample inventory adjustment. Required for PDMA compliance when quantity_adjusted is non-zero. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: expired|damaged|lost|stolen|count_correction|returned_to_warehouse|destroyed — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this sample inventory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  discrepancy_quantity varchar [note: 'Net difference between the physical count and the system-recorded quantity on hand during reconciliation. Non-zero values trigger a PDMA compliance investigation. Positive = overage; Negative = shortage.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the sample lot as printed on the package. Samples past this date must not be disbursed and must be removed from inventory per cGMP and PDMA requirements.']
  hcp_dea_number varchar [note: 'DEA registration number of the HCP, required when distributing controlled substance samples. Validates prescribing authority for scheduled drug samples per DEA regulations.']
  hcp_license_number varchar [note: 'State medical license number of the HCP at the time of sample disbursement. Required by PDMA to verify the HCP is a licensed practitioner authorized to receive samples. Captured at point of disbursement.']
  hcp_signature_captured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HCP\'s electronic signature was captured at the time of sample disbursement, as required by PDMA. True = signature obtained; False = signature not obtained (requires justification).']
  hcp_signature_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the HCP\'s electronic signature was captured for the sample disbursement. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and PDMA audit trail.']
  inventory_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this sample inventory position record. Used for PDMA audit trails, reconciliation reports, and regulatory submissions. Generated by the sample management system (Veeva CRM or SAP MM).']
  inventory_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the sample inventory position. Active = open and in use; Reconciled = periodic reconciliation completed; Closed = inventory position closed; Suspended = temporarily frozen pending investigation; Pending Review = flagged for compliance review.']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturing lot or batch number assigned to the sample units in this inventory position. Critical for product recall management, quality investigations, and PDMA lot-level accountability.']
  ndc_code varchar [note: 'FDA-assigned National Drug Code uniquely identifying the drug product, dosage form, and package size of the sample. Required for PDMA compliance reporting and lot-level traceability.']
  package_size varchar [note: 'Number of units (tablets, capsules, vials, etc.) contained in each sample package. Used to calculate total units disbursed and for PDMA annual accountability reporting.']
  pdma_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sample transaction meets all PDMA compliance requirements (HCP signature captured, valid license verified, request form on file, quantity within limits). True = compliant; False = non-compliant, requires remediation.']
  quantity_adjusted varchar [note: 'Net quantity adjustment applied to the inventory position (positive = increase, negative = decrease). Used for inventory corrections, expired sample write-offs, and reconciliation discrepancy resolution.']
  quantity_disbursed varchar [note: 'Number of sample units disbursed to a Healthcare Professional (HCP) in this transaction. Zero for non-disbursement transaction types. Used for PDMA annual sample accountability and Sunshine Act reporting.']
  quantity_on_hand varchar [note: 'Current physical inventory count of sample units held by the sales representative for this product/lot combination at the time of this record. Used for reconciliation and PDMA compliance.']
  quantity_received varchar [note: 'Number of sample units received by the sales representative from the warehouse, CMO, or another rep in this transaction. Zero for non-receipt transaction types.']
  reconciliation_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal quarter (e.g., \'2024-Q1\') to which this inventory reconciliation record belongs. PDMA requires periodic reconciliation of sample inventories. Used for compliance reporting and audit.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the PDMA sample reconciliation process for this inventory position and period. Discrepancy Identified = physical count does not match system records; Resolved = discrepancy investigated and closed.']
  sample_form_type varchar [note: 'Finished dosage form (FDF) type of the sample product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injectable). Used for inventory categorization, storage planning, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injectable|topical|inhaler|liquid|patch|other — promote to reference product]']
  sample_request_form_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the HCP\'s written or electronic sample request form (SRF) associated with this disbursement. PDMA requires a signed request for each sample disbursement. Links to the eTMF or Veeva Vault document.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this sample inventory record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Veeva CRM, SAP MM, and Salesforce Health Cloud in the Silver layer.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for the sample as specified in the product labeling and CoA. Used to ensure samples are stored appropriately by the sales rep and to flag potential quality deviations.']
  strength varchar [note: 'Dosage strength of the sample product (e.g., \'10 mg\', \'500 mg/5 mL\'). Distinguishes between different strength variants of the same product for inventory tracking and PDMA reporting.']
  sunshine_act_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this sample disbursement transaction must be reported under the Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments Program) to CMS. True = reportable transfer of value to HCP.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area classification of the sample product (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Used for brand performance tracking, sample budget allocation, and commercial analytics.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'The real-world business date on which the sample transaction (disbursement, receipt, transfer, etc.) occurred. Used as the principal event date for PDMA reporting and Sunshine Act transparency reporting.']
  transaction_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the sample transaction was recorded in the system (Veeva CRM or SAP). Provides sub-day precision for audit trail and compliance investigations.']
  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the sample movement or inventory event. Disbursement = sample given to HCP; Receipt = samples received by rep; Transfer = rep-to-rep or warehouse transfer; Adjustment = inventory correction; Reconciliation = periodic count reconciliation; Return = samples returned to warehouse; Destruction = samples destroyed per policy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: disbursement|receipt|transfer|adjustment|reconciliation|return|destruction — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this sample inventory record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']

  Note: 'Unified sample management product tracking sample inventory positions, all transaction movements (disbursements, receipts, transfers, adjustments, reconciliations), and PDMA compliance for each sales representative'
}

  base_bonus_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Base incentive bonus amount calculated before any adjustments, accelerators, or deductions. Determined by attainment percentage and compensation plan formula.']
  bonus_tier varchar [note: 'Bonus tier achieved based on attainment percentage. Each tier corresponds to a different payout multiplier or fixed amount per the compensation plan.']
  business_unit varchar [note: 'Business unit or division to which this incentive compensation is charged. Used for financial reporting and cost allocation.']
  calculation_date date [note: 'Date on which the incentive compensation was calculated by the system or compensation analyst.']
  compensation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the incentive compensation record. Tracks progression from calculation through approval to payout.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this incentive compensation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.']
  crm_record_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the corresponding record in the CRM system (Veeva CRM or Salesforce Health Cloud) that tracks the sales activities underlying this compensation.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (quota, sales, bonus amounts).']
  erp_document_number varchar [note: 'Document number generated in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA) when this incentive compensation expense was posted to the general ledger.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'General ledger account code to which this incentive compensation expense is posted. Aligns with chart of accounts for financial reporting.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this incentive compensation record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes and data lineage.']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Audit trail field for compliance and change tracking.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments related to this incentive compensation record. Used for additional context, special circumstances, or audit trail documentation.']
  payout_date date [note: 'Date on which the incentive compensation was paid or is scheduled to be paid to the representative. Aligns with payroll cycle.']
  payout_status varchar [note: 'Status of the actual payment disbursement to the sales representative. Tracks integration with payroll or finance systems.']
  payroll_batch_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier of the payroll batch in which this incentive compensation was included for payment processing. Links to HR payroll system.']
  profit_center varchar [note: 'Profit center code for internal profitability reporting. Used to track incentive compensation expense by profit-responsible unit.']

  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record. Audit trail field for compliance and data governance.']

  Note: 'Incentive compensation calculation record for each sales representative per performance period. }

Each record links one brand to one payer account with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific formulary placement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, each brand must secure formulary placement with multiple payers to ensure patient access across different health plans, and each payer maintains formularies covering hundreds of brands across therapeutic areas. The formulary position is an actively managed business entity where market access teams negotiate tier placement, utilization management restrictions, and rebate terms with each payer for each brand. This relationship has substantial relationship-specific data including tier, restrictions, rebates, and coverage dates that belong to neither the brand nor the payer alone.'
}

  primary_therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The principal therapeutic area in which the KOL holds recognised scientific expertise (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Aligns with the company\'s therapeutic area taxonomy for strategic segmentation.']
  professional_title varchar [note: 'Highest academic or professional credential held by the KOL (e.g., MD, PhD, PharmD). Used for credentialing validation and communication protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|PhD|MD-PhD|PharmD|DO|MBBS|MSc|Other — promote to reference product]']
  profile_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the KOL master profile record was first created in the medical affairs data product, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  profile_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the KOL master profile record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change detection, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.']
  publication_planning_participant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the KOL is actively engaged in the company\'s publication planning programme as an author, reviewer, or steering committee member. Managed via Veeva MedComms publication planning module.']
  relationship_depth_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric score (0–100 scale) reflecting the depth and quality of the company\'s medical affairs relationship with the KOL, based on engagement frequency, interaction type, responsiveness, and collaboration history. Sourced from Veeva MedComms engagement analytics.']
  rwe_collaborator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the KOL is actively engaged as a collaborator in the company\'s Real-World Evidence (RWE) or Real-World Data (RWD) generation programmes, including registry studies, database analyses, or observational research.']
  secondary_therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Additional therapeutic area(s) in which the KOL has recognised expertise beyond their primary focus. Supports cross-functional engagement planning across multiple disease areas.']
  sunshine_act_ytd_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Cumulative year-to-date total of all transfers of value (payments, honoraria, meals, travel, research grants) made to this KOL reportable under the U.S. Sunshine Act / Open Payments programme (42 CFR §403.904), expressed in USD. Resets annually at the start of each reporting year.']
  total_citations varchar [note: 'Cumulative number of citations received across all publications attributed to the KOL, as sourced from Scopus or Web of Science. Complements H-index as a measure of scientific impact.']
  total_publications varchar [note: 'Total number of peer-reviewed publications (journal articles, reviews, meta-analyses) attributed to the KOL as indexed in PubMed or Scopus. Reflects scientific output volume for influence scoring.']
  veeva_medcomms_code varchar [note: 'External identifier assigned to this KOL record within Veeva MedComms, enabling cross-system traceability and synchronisation with the source system of record.']

  Note: 'Master record for Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and emerging thought leaders relevant to the companys therapeutic areas. Captures academic affiliations, H-index and publication metrics, therapeutic area expertise, clinical trial participation history, advisory board memberships, congress speaking engagements, influence tier classification (global, regional, national, local), digital influence score, conflict-of-interest disclosure status, aggregate transparency reporting totals (Sunshine Act/Open Payments, EFPIA disclosure), fair market value tier assignment, and engagement history summary.   gap_source varchar [note: 'The origin or trigger that led to identification of this evidence gap. Payer feedback indicates reimbursement-driven gaps; regulatory_request indicates FDA/EMA post-marketing commitments; publication_gap_analysis indicates systematic literature review findings.   gap_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the evidence gap record, tracking progression from initial identification through study execution to resolution or closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identified|under_review|study_planned|study_ongoing|addressed|closed|deprioritised — promote to reference product]']
  gap_title varchar [note: 'Short, human-readable title summarising the evidence gap, used in dashboards, integrated evidence plans, and stakeholder presentations.']
  gap_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the nature of the evidence gap: clinical_efficacy (unmet proof of benefit), clinical_safety (uncharacterised risk), health_economic (HEOR/cost-effectiveness), real_world_effectiveness (RWE/RWD gap), mechanistic_biomarker (MOA/biomarker gap), patient_reported_outcomes (PRO/QoL gap).']
  geography_scope varchar [note: 'The geographic region or country scope for which the evidence gap is relevant (e.g., USA, EU5, JPN, global). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional designations aligned with regulatory and market access strategy.']
  hta_body varchar [note: 'The specific HTA body or payer organisation that raised or is associated with this evidence gap (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, CADTH, ICER). Populated when payer_relevance_flag is True.']
  identification_date date [note: 'The date on which this evidence gap was formally identified and entered into the evidence planning system. Represents the business event date, distinct from the record creation timestamp.']
  iep_reference_code varchar [note: 'Reference code linking this evidence gap to the formal Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP) document for the compound or therapeutic area. Enables traceability between individual gaps and the overarching evidence strategy.']
  indication varchar [note: 'The specific disease indication or patient population subgroup for which the evidence gap has been identified (e.g., relapsed/refractory DLBCL, treatment-naïve Type 2 Diabetes). May be more granular than therapeutic area.']
  kol_identified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) or external scientific expert has been identified to support the evidence generation activity addressing this gap. True = KOL identified and engaged.']
  last_reviewed_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal review of this evidence gap by the medical affairs team, evidence planning committee, or advisory board. Used to ensure gaps are periodically reassessed for relevance and priority.']
  payer_relevance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this evidence gap has been identified as relevant to payer or health technology assessment (HTA) decision-making, reimbursement negotiations, or formulary access. True = payer/HTA relevance confirmed.']
  priority_tier varchar [note: 'Prioritisation tier assigned by the medical affairs function reflecting urgency, strategic importance, and resource allocation. Critical gaps typically block regulatory submissions or payer negotiations; high gaps affect label expansions or market access.']
  proposed_study_type varchar [note: 'The type of study or evidence generation activity proposed to address this gap. RCT (Randomised Controlled Trial), observational, RWE/RWD study, IIT (Investigator-Initiated Trial), ISS (Investigator-Sponsored Study), HEOR model, systematic review, registry, or biomarker study. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rct|observational|rwe_rwd|iit|iss|heor_model|systematic_review|registry|biomarker_study — promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The regulatory authority that issued the post-marketing commitment or requirement associated with this evidence gap, if applicable. Populated only when regulatory_commitment_flag is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|NMPA|WHO|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_commitment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this evidence gap is associated with a formal post-marketing commitment or post-marketing requirement issued by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA). True = formal regulatory commitment exists.']
  responsible_function varchar [note: 'The internal medical affairs or cross-functional team accountable for driving resolution of this evidence gap (e.g., HEOR, RWE, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_affairs|heor|rwe|clinical_development|regulatory_affairs|market_access|pharmacovigilance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  review_cycle_months varchar [note: 'The scheduled review frequency in months for this evidence gap (e.g., 3, 6, 12 months). Drives automated review reminders and ensures the evidence gap register remains current.']
  strategic_importance_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (1–10) assigned during integrated evidence planning to reflect the strategic importance of addressing this gap relative to the compound\'s lifecycle, competitive landscape, and market access objectives. Higher scores indicate greater strategic value.']
  target_patient_population varchar [note: 'Description of the specific patient population or subgroup for which the evidence gap exists (e.g., paediatric patients, elderly patients ≥75 years, patients with renal impairment, biomarker-positive subgroup).']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The disease or therapeutic area to which this evidence gap belongs (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company\'s therapeutic area taxonomy used across clinical development and commercial functions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this evidence gap record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and change tracking for evidence planning governance.']

  Note: 'Master record tracking identified evidence gaps in the scientific knowledge base for a compound or therapeutic area. Captures gap description, gap type (clinical efficacy, clinical safety, health economic, real-world effectiveness, mechanistic/biomarker, patient-reported outcomes), source of gap identification (payer feedback, regulatory request, publication gap analysis, advisory board insight), therapeutic area, compound, priority tier, proposed study type to address the gap, responsible medical affairs function, target resolution timeline, and current status. Drives evidence generation strategy, HEOR/RWE study prioritization, and integrated evidence planning.'

Table medical.medical_advisory_board_membership {
  medical_advisory_board_membership_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for medical_advisory_board_membership']
  contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference identifier to the formal engagement contract or consulting agreement governing this specific KOL membership on this advisory board']
  medical_advisory_board_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the medical advisory board on which the KOL serves as a member']
  medical_kol_profile_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the Key Opinion Leader profile who holds membership on the advisory board']
  advisory_board_membership_code varchar [note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for this specific membership relationship record']
  appointment_date date [note: 'Date on which the KOL was formally appointed to this advisory board, which may precede the membership start date if there was a nomination and approval process']
  coi_disclosure_on_file boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a conflict-of-interest disclosure specific to this advisory board membership has been collected and is on file for compliance purposes']
  honorarium_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Fair market value honorarium amount paid to this specific KOL for their participation on this advisory board, subject to transparency reporting requirements under Sunshine Act/EFPIA']
  honorarium_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the honorarium amount specific to this membership']
  last_attendance_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent advisory board meeting attended by this KOL, used for engagement recency tracking']
  meeting_attendance_count varchar [note: 'Cumulative number of advisory board meetings attended by this KOL for this specific board, used for engagement quality assessment and honorarium calculation validation']
  member_role varchar [note: 'Specific role or designation held by the KOL within this advisory board (e.g., Chair, Vice Chair, Member), determining responsibilities and governance authority']
  membership_end_date date [note: 'Date on which the KOL membership term concluded or is scheduled to conclude, either through term expiration, resignation, or board dissolution']
  membership_start_date date [note: 'Date on which the KOL formally commenced their membership term on this advisory board, as documented in the engagement contract']
  nomination_source varchar [note: 'Source or function that nominated this KOL for membership on this advisory board (e.g., Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, specific MSL territory)']
  participation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this specific membership relationship, indicating whether the KOL is actively participating, on leave, or has concluded their term']
  transparency_reported boolean [note: 'Indicates whether transfers of value associated with this specific membership have been reported to applicable transparency registries (Sunshine Act, EFPIA disclosure)']

  Note: 'This association product represents the membership relationship between Key Opinion Leaders and Medical Advisory Boards. It captures the formal appointment, participation terms, compensation arrangements, and engagement metrics for each KOL serving on each advisory board. Each record links one KOL to one advisory board with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific membership relationship, including role designation, tenure dates, honorarium details, meeting attendance tracking, and compliance documentation.. Existence Justification: Advisory board membership is a formally managed business relationship in pharmaceutical medical affairs. A single KOL can serve on multiple advisory boards simultaneously (e.g., an oncology KOL may sit on boards for different therapeutic indications or development programs), and each advisory board has multiple KOL members by design (typical member counts range from 8-15 experts). Medical affairs teams actively create, manage, and track these memberships with formal contracts, honoraria, meeting attendance, and compliance documentation.'
}

Table medical.congress_attendance {
  congress_attendance_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the congress attendance record']
  congress_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the congress event record identifying which medical congress was attended']
  msl_profile_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the MSL profile record identifying which Medical Science Liaison attended the congress']
  attendance_end_date date [note: 'The date the MSL concluded attendance at the congress. May differ from congress end_date if MSL attended only partial days. Used for travel planning and expense reconciliation. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  attendance_role varchar [note: 'The functional role the MSL performed at this congress (e.g., Attendee, Presenter, Booth Staff, Satellite Speaker). Determines activity expectations and post-congress reporting requirements. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  attendance_start_date date [note: 'The date the MSL began attending the congress. May differ from congress start_date if MSL attended only partial days. Used for travel planning and expense reconciliation. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  booth_duty_assigned boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the MSL was assigned booth duty shifts during the congress. Drives scheduling and resource allocation. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this congress attendance record was created in the system.']
  estimated_total_cost decimal [note: 'Estimated total cost for this MSL\'s congress attendance including registration, travel, accommodation, and per diem. Used for budget planning and ROI analysis.']
  insights_submitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the MSL submitted post-congress insights and competitive intelligence reports. Used for compliance and knowledge capture tracking.']
  kol_meetings_conducted varchar [note: 'Number of Key Opinion Leader (KOL) meetings or engagements the MSL conducted during this congress attendance. Core metric for congress ROI assessment. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  msl_attendee_count varchar [note: 'Number of Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) deployed to attend and engage at the congress. Used for resource allocation planning and MSL activity reporting. [Moved from congress_event: This is an aggregate count that should be derived from the congress_attendance association table, not stored redundantly on congress_event. The source of truth for MSL attendance is the association records.]']
  post_congress_report_date date [note: 'Date the MSL submitted their post-congress activity report and insights. Used for compliance tracking and timely knowledge capture.']
  presentation_delivered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the MSL delivered an oral or poster presentation at this congress. Used for performance tracking and scientific output measurement. Sourced from detection phase relationship data.']
  registration_date date [note: 'Date the MSL was officially registered for the congress. Used to track early-bird eligibility and budget commitment timing.']
  registration_fee_amount decimal [note: 'Total registration fee paid for this MSL\'s congress attendance. Used for budget tracking and congress cost analysis.']
  registration_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the MSL\'s registration and attendance for this congress. Drives workflow and budget commitment tracking.']
  travel_approved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether travel and accommodation for this attendance has been approved by management. Gates logistics booking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this congress attendance record was last updated.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the attendance event between MSL profiles and congress events. It captures the operational record of MSL deployment to medical and scientific congresses, including attendance logistics, engagement activities, and post-congress outcomes. Each record links one MSL to one congress with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific attendance instance.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical medical affairs operations, MSLs are deployed to multiple congresses throughout the year based on therapeutic area alignment, strategic importance, and territory coverage. Each congress hosts multiple MSLs from the same organization performing different roles (presenters, booth staff, attendees). Congress attendance is an actively managed operational process involving planning, approval workflows, budget allocation, logistics coordination, and post-event reporting. The business explicitly tracks attendance as a distinct entity with its own lifecycle and attributes.'
}

Table market.access_strategy {

  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Access strategies are country-specific, requiring regulatory authority names, HTA body details, reimbursement frameworks, and market access tier classifications for strategic planning and submission p']
  exclusivity_period_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Access strategies depend on regulatory exclusivity (orphan, pediatric, data) to determine market entry barriers, competitive landscape, and reimbursement positioning. Exclusivity periods directly info']
  indication_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific therapeutic indication or disease area for which this access strategy applies, enabling indication-level access differentiation.']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to hcp.hcp_master. Business justification: Access strategies target specific KOL physicians for advocacy, advisory boards, and peer influence. Market access teams identify and engage key physicians to support formulary positioning and HTA subm']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the pharmaceutical product (drug product or biologic) for which this market access strategy is defined.']
  patent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Access strategies must reference patent protection to align launch timing with exclusivity windows, inform pricing negotiations, and plan LOE transitions. Market access teams require patent expiry dat']
  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Market access strategies must operate within compliance programs governing promotional activities, transparency reporting (Sunshine Act/EFPIA), and anti-kickback rules. Compliance oversight is mandato']
  access_barrier_severity varchar [note: 'Overall severity rating of the identified access barriers for this strategy: low (minor hurdles), medium (manageable barriers), high (significant barriers requiring targeted remediation), or critical (barriers that may prevent market access).']
  access_barrier_summary varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the primary identified access barriers for this product in the target geography and payer segment (e.g., lack of comparative clinical evidence, high ICER, step therapy requirements, prior authorization burden). Confidential strategic content.']
  access_objective varchar [note: 'Overarching strategic access objective statement for this product in the target geography and payer segment (e.g., \'Achieve preferred formulary tier 1 placement in 80% of commercial plans within 12 months of launch\'). Confidential strategic business information.']
  actual_launch_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the product was commercially launched in the specified geography and payer segment. Compared against planned_launch_date to measure launch execution performance.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which this market access strategy was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from under_review to approved lifecycle status.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the senior leader (e.g., VP Market Access, Chief Commercial Officer) who formally approved this access strategy.']
  copay_assistance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a copay assistance or copay card program is included in this access strategy to reduce patient out-of-pocket costs and improve commercial insurance access.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this market access strategy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and SOX requirements.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this market access strategy becomes operative and binding for downstream access activities including HTA submissions, payer contracting, and patient support programs.']
  effective_until_date date [note: 'Date on which this market access strategy expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended strategies. Used to manage strategy lifecycle and trigger renewal workflows.']
  gross_to_net_target_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target gross-to-net revenue reduction percentage for this access strategy, representing the expected aggregate discount, rebate, and allowance burden relative to gross list price. Critical for P&L planning and net revenue forecasting. Confidential financial data.']
  heor_study_plan varchar [note: 'Summary of the Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) study plan, including cost-effectiveness models, budget impact analyses, and quality-of-life studies planned to support payer value dossiers and HTA submissions. Confidential strategic content.']
  hta_body_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the primary HTA body responsible for evaluating this product in the target geography (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC, CADTH, AIFA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NICE|G-BA|HAS|PBAC|CADTH|AIFA|SMC|NCPE|TLV|ZIN — promote to reference product]']
  hta_outcome varchar [note: 'Outcome of the HTA review by the primary HTA body: pending (under review), positive (recommended), positive_with_restriction (recommended with clinical/population restrictions), negative (not recommended), withdrawn (submission withdrawn), or not_applicable.']
  hta_strategy varchar [note: 'Description of the Health Technology Assessment (HTA) strategy including target HTA bodies (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC), submission sequencing, evidence package approach, and comparator selection rationale. Confidential strategic content.']
  hta_submission_actual_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the HTA dossier was submitted to the primary HTA body. Compared against hta_submission_planned_date to track submission timeliness.']
  hta_submission_planned_date date [note: 'Planned date for submission of the HTA dossier or value dossier to the primary HTA body. Used for launch sequencing and access readiness milestone tracking.']
  icer_threshold_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Payer or HTA body willingness-to-pay threshold per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) or other health outcome unit in the target geography. Used to assess pricing headroom and value-based pricing strategy. Confidential strategic financial data.']
  icer_threshold_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the ICER willingness-to-pay threshold applicable in the target geography (e.g., GBP for NICE, EUR for G-BA/HAS, USD for ICER US).']
  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the access strategy document: draft (being authored), under_review (in approval workflow), approved (signed off), active (being executed), on_hold (paused), superseded (replaced by a newer version), or retired (no longer applicable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|active|on_hold|superseded|retired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  list_price_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross list price (WAC — Wholesale Acquisition Cost in the US, or equivalent list price in other geographies) for the product in the target geography. Confidential commercial pricing data.']
  list_price_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the gross list price of the product in the target geography (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).']
  patient_support_program_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a patient support program (copay assistance, patient assistance program, hub services) is included as a component of this access strategy to improve patient access and adherence.']
  payer_segment varchar [note: 'Specific payer segment or channel targeted by this access strategy (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, VA/DoD, Private Insurance, NHS, Statutory Health Insurance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Commercial|Medicare Part D|Medicaid|VA/DoD|NHS|Statutory Health Insurance|Private Insurance|Integrated Delivery Network — promote to reference product]']
  planned_launch_date date [note: 'Target date for commercial product launch in the specified geography and payer segment, as defined in the launch sequencing plan. Drives milestone planning and access readiness timelines.']
  reimbursement_pathway varchar [note: 'Regulatory and payer reimbursement pathway pursued for this product: standard (routine formulary review), accelerated (expedited review), managed_entry (conditional coverage), risk_sharing (payer-manufacturer risk agreement), outcomes_based (payment linked to clinical outcomes), named_patient, or compassionate_use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|accelerated|managed_entry|risk_sharing|outcomes_based|named_patient|compassionate_use — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  remediation_plan varchar [note: 'Description of planned remediation actions to address identified access barriers, including evidence generation plans, payer engagement activities, managed entry agreement negotiations, and patient support program design. Confidential strategic content.']
  rwe_rwd_plan varchar [note: 'Description of the Real-World Evidence (RWE) and Real-World Data (RWD) generation plan supporting payer negotiations, HTA submissions, and outcomes-based contracting. Includes study designs, data sources, and timelines. Confidential strategic content.']
  strategy_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the access strategy, used in cross-functional communications, HTA submissions, and payer contracting documents. Format: MAS-<ProductCode>-<Year>.']
  strategy_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the market access strategy, typically including the product name, indication, and geography (e.g., \'Oncology Product X — US Formulary Access Strategy 2025\').']
  strategy_owner varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the Market Access lead or director accountable for developing and executing this access strategy.']
  strategy_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the access strategy by its business purpose: launch (initial market entry), lifecycle (ongoing management), indication_expansion (new indication), line_extension (new formulation/dosage), or biosimilar_defense (protecting market share against biosimilar entry).']
  strategy_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the access strategy document following major.minor versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Supports document lifecycle management and audit trail requirements.']
  target_formulary_tier varchar [note: 'Desired formulary tier placement targeted by this access strategy for the specified payer segment. Tier 1 represents preferred/lowest cost-share; specialty and non_formulary represent restricted access positions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this market access strategy record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  value_proposition varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the clinical, economic, and humanistic value proposition communicated to payers and HTA bodies to justify formulary placement and reimbursement. Confidential strategic content.']

  Note: 'Master record defining the market access strategy for a pharmaceutical product in a given geography or payer segment. Captures overarching access objectives, value proposition, target formulary tier, reimbursement pathway, HTA strategy, launch sequencing plan, identified access barriers with severity and remediation actions, key access milestones with planned and actual dates, and milestone status tracking. Serves as the strategic anchor for all downstream access activities including HTA submissions, payer contracting, patient support programs, and systematic access gap management.'
}
