Table market.hta_submission {
  hta_submission_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for the HTA submission record. Serves as the primary key for the full lifecycle of a single HTA engagement from planning through decision.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: HTA submissions target specific country regulatory authorities and HTA bodies tracked in country master. Required for submission planning, regulatory compliance tracking, and reimbursement pathway det']
  exclusivity_period_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: HTA bodies evaluate regulatory exclusivity periods when assessing reimbursement value, budget impact over the protected timeframe, and managed entry agreement terms. Exclusivity data is mandatory in m']
  indication_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific therapeutic indication for which HTA is being sought. A single product may have multiple HTA submissions across different indications.']
  internal_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: HTA submissions are funded through internal orders that track costs for dossier development, external consultants, agency fees, and translation services. Essential for R&D capitalization decisions and']
  market_heor_study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary HEOR study record that underpins the economic model and value dossier submitted to the HTA body. Links to the medical affairs HEOR study asset.']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the drug product (DP) or finished dosage form (FDF) that is the subject of this HTA submission. Links to the master product record.']
  patent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: HTA dossiers cite patent protection status to demonstrate value proposition duration and justify pricing over the protected period. HTA bodies evaluate patent expiry when assessing long-term budget im']
  actual_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the HTA dossier was formally submitted to the HTA body. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp for the submission transaction, used to calculate review timelines and clock-start for statutory deadlines.']
  appeal_filed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the company has filed a formal appeal or clarification request against the HTA body\'s decision. Triggers the appeal lifecycle tracking and legal review process.']
  appeal_outcome varchar [note: 'Outcome of the formal appeal filed against the HTA body\'s initial decision. Populated only when appeal_filed is True. Drives revision of the decision_type and downstream contracting actions.']
  atc_code varchar [note: 'WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the drug product subject to this HTA submission. Used by HTA bodies to identify the therapeutic class and relevant comparators.']
  benefit_rating varchar [note: 'The HTA body\'s formal rating of the added therapeutic benefit of the drug compared to the appropriate comparator. Terminology varies by body: G-BA uses \'major/considerable/minor/non-quantifiable/no added benefit\'; NICE uses \'highly clinically effective/clinically effective\'; HAS uses ASMR grades I-V. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: major|considerable|minor|non_quantifiable|no_added_benefit|asmr_i|asmr_ii|asmr_iii|asmr_iv|asmr_v — promote to reference product]']
  comparator_description varchar [note: 'Description of the comparator treatment(s) used in the clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body. HTA bodies require comparison against the current standard of care or the most appropriate comparator (e.g., best supportive care, existing first-line therapy). Critical for benefit assessment.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this HTA submission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.']
  decision_date date [note: 'Date on which the HTA body issued its formal recommendation or decision. Used to calculate time-to-decision, trigger downstream payer contracting timelines, and manage reimbursement listing effective dates.']
  decision_type varchar [note: 'The formal recommendation type issued by the HTA body following review of the submission: positive (recommended for reimbursement), negative (not recommended), restricted (recommended for a subset of the indicated population), conditional (recommended subject to managed access or further evidence), deferred (decision postponed), or not recommended.']
  dossier_reference varchar [note: 'The official dossier or file reference number assigned by the HTA body upon receipt of the submission. Used for all formal correspondence and tracking within the HTA body\'s system.']
  economic_model_type varchar [note: 'Type of health economic model included in the HTA submission dossier. Cost-utility analysis (CUA) using QALYs is standard for NICE; cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) is used by other bodies. Determines the analytical framework for reimbursement recommendation.']
  ectd_sequence_number varchar [note: 'The eCTD sequence number associated with the regulatory submission that supports this HTA dossier, linking the HTA submission to the corresponding marketing authorisation application (MAA/NDA/BLA) in the regulatory submission system.']
  evidence_package_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the primary clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body: randomised controlled trial (RCT), observational study, indirect treatment comparison (ITC), mixed treatment comparison (MTC), single-arm trial, or real-world evidence (RWE). Influences the HTA body\'s confidence in the benefit assessment.']
  external_agency varchar [note: 'Name of any external agency, health economics consultancy, or contract research organisation (CRO) engaged to support dossier preparation, economic modelling, or submission management for this HTA engagement.']
  hta_body_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the national or regional HTA body to which this submission is directed (e.g., NICE for England, HAS for France, G-BA for Germany, CADTH for Canada, PBAC for Australia). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NICE|HAS|G-BA|CADTH|PBAC|SMC|AIFA|TLV|ZIN|NCPE|ANVISA|INFARMED — promote to reference product]']
  icer_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the ICER value submitted (e.g., GBP for NICE, EUR for HAS/G-BA, CAD for CADTH, AUD for PBAC). Required to interpret the submitted ICER in the correct monetary context.']
  icer_submitted decimal(18,4) [note: 'The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) as submitted by the company in the economic model, expressed in cost per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gained or cost per life year gained. Confidential as it reflects internal pricing and modelling assumptions used in payer negotiations.']
  inn varchar [note: 'The WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) that is the subject of this HTA submission. Used by HTA bodies as the standard drug identifier.']
  managed_access_scheme boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HTA decision is conditional on a managed access scheme (MAS), such as NICE\'s Managed Access Agreements (MAA) or Cancer Drugs Fund (CDF) arrangements, requiring further real-world evidence collection during the access period.']
  patient_access_program boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a patient access program (PAP) or copay assistance program has been established in conjunction with this HTA submission to support patient affordability and access pending or following the reimbursement decision.']
  planned_submission_date date [note: 'Target date on which the completed HTA dossier is planned to be formally submitted to the HTA body. Used for project planning, resource allocation, and commercial launch timeline alignment.']
  price_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the recommended price range values (e.g., GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD). Required to interpret price bounds in the correct monetary context for each jurisdiction.']
  recommended_price_lower decimal(18,4) [note: 'Lower bound of the price range recommended or implied by the HTA body\'s decision, expressed in the local currency. Used in payer contracting and gross-to-net revenue management. Confidential as it reflects sensitive pricing negotiation data.']
  recommended_price_upper decimal(18,4) [note: 'Upper bound of the price range recommended or implied by the HTA body\'s decision, expressed in the local currency. Used alongside the lower bound to define the acceptable price corridor for payer negotiations and contracting.']
  regulatory_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the marketing authorisation (MA) was granted by the relevant regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) for the indication covered by this HTA submission. HTA submissions typically follow regulatory approval; this date anchors the HTA timeline.']
  reimbursement_conditions varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to the HTA body\'s reimbursement recommendation (e.g., restricted to second-line use, mandatory prior authorisation, patient registry requirement, managed access scheme). Drives contracting and access program design.']
  rwe_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the HTA body\'s decision requires the generation and submission of real-world evidence (RWE) or real-world data (RWD) as a condition of continued reimbursement or as part of a managed access arrangement.']
  submission_lead varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the internal market access lead or HTA manager responsible for coordinating and owning this submission. Used for accountability, escalation, and stakeholder communication.']
  submission_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the HTA submission, used in correspondence with the HTA body and in regulatory information management systems (RIMS). Typically follows the HTA body\'s own dossier numbering convention.']
  submission_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the HTA submission, tracking progression from planning through dossier preparation, formal submission, review, and final decision or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|in_preparation|submitted|under_review|decision_issued|withdrawn|resubmission — promote to reference product]']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the HTA submission: initial submission for a new indication, resubmission following a negative decision, renewal of an existing reimbursement listing, line extension for a new formulation or dose, or supplemental submission with new evidence.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The disease area or therapeutic category covered by this HTA submission (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company\'s internal therapeutic area taxonomy and the ATC classification system.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this HTA submission record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  value_dossier_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the global value dossier (GVD) used as the basis for this HTA submission. Tracks which version of the evidence synthesis and value story was submitted, enabling audit trail and version control across multiple country submissions.']
  willingness_to_pay_threshold decimal(18,4) [note: 'The HTA body\'s published or applied willingness-to-pay threshold per QALY (or equivalent outcome unit) for the relevant jurisdiction at the time of submission. Used to assess whether the submitted ICER falls within the acceptable range for reimbursement recommendation.']

  Note: 'Master record for the full lifecycle of Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions to bodies such as NICE (UK), HAS (France), G-BA (Germany), CADTH (Canada), and PBAC (Australia). Captures submission planning, dossier preparation, submission date, HTA body, therapeutic indication, comparator, clinical evidence package, economic model type, submission status, and the resulting formal decision including recommendation type (positive, negative, restricted, conditional), benefit rating, added therapeutic benefit classification, recommended price range, and reimbursement conditions. Owns both the submission event and the decision outcome as lifecycle stages of a single HTA engagement. Drives downstream payer contracting and pricing decisions.'
}

  submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the value dossier was formally submitted to the target HTA body, payer, or formulary committee.']
  target_indication varchar [note: 'Specific disease or condition for which the product is being positioned in the dossier (e.g., metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis). Should align with the approved or sought label indication.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_hta|regional_hta|commercial_payer|pbm|gpo|government_formulary|hospital_formulary — promote to reference product]']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Broad disease area or medical specialty the dossier addresses (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company\'s therapeutic area taxonomy.']

  payment_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the rebate payment was received from or remitted to the payer. Null until payment is confirmed. Used for cash flow reconciliation and gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.']

  payment_reference varchar [note: 'Bank or ERP payment reference number (e.g., SAP payment document number or wire transfer reference) associated with the settlement of this rebate claim. Used for cash application and bank reconciliation.']
  prior_period_adjustment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rebate claim includes a true-up or correction for a prior reporting period. When true, the adjustment_amount field captures the prior period correction value for audit trail purposes.']
  rebate_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'Contractually agreed rebate rate expressed as a percentage of WAC or net price applicable to this claim. May reflect a base rate, a performance tier rate, or a blended rate depending on claim type.']
  rebate_tier varchar [note: 'Contractual performance tier achieved during the claim period that determines the applicable rebate rate. Higher tiers typically correspond to greater market share or formulary access levels.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this rebate claim record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this rebate claim record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the rebate claim was formally submitted to the payer or PBM. Used to track timeliness against contractual submission deadlines and to calculate aging of outstanding claims.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area classification of the product covered by this rebate claim (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Used for gross-to-net reporting and market access analytics by franchise.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit in which eligible_units are expressed for this rebate claim (e.g., prescription, unit dose, pack). Must align with the unit of measure defined in the underlying managed care contract.']
  wac_price decimal(18,4) [note: 'Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per unit at the time of the claim period. Serves as the base price from which rebate percentages are calculated for gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of rebate claims submitted to or received from payers and PBMs under managed care contracts. Captures claim period, contracted product, eligible units, applicable rebate rate, calculated rebate amount, dispute status, and payment date. Feeds gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting and rebate liability accruals in the finance domain.'

  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Clinical therapeutic area classification of the drug product subject to this GTN adjustment (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Enables GTN deduction analysis by disease area for portfolio management.']
  units_sold decimal(18,4) [note: 'Number of drug product units (e.g., bottles, vials, packs) sold during the adjustment period that are subject to this GTN deduction. Used for per-unit rebate calculations and volume-based tier determination.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|withdrawn|expired — promote to reference product]']

  list_price_wac decimal(18,4) [note: 'Approved Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) or ex-factory list price per unit for the product in the specified market and channel.   net_price decimal(18,4) [note: 'Approved net price after application of mandatory rebates, statutory discounts, and government-mandated deductions. Represents the effective realized price per unit. Expressed in currency_code.']
  pack_size_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the pack configuration to which this pricing decision applies (e.g., \'30 tablets x 10mg\', \'1 vial x 100mg/10mL\'). Ensures unambiguous identification of the priced SKU.']
  price_change_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage change in list price (WAC) relative to the immediately preceding approved pricing decision for the same product, market, and channel. Positive values indicate a price increase; negative values indicate a price decrease.']
  price_per_unit_type varchar [note: 'Defines the unit basis on which all price values in this decision are expressed (e.g., per pack, per tablet, per vial, per mg of active pharmaceutical ingredient, per mL, per dose).']
  pricing_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for the pricing decision, documenting the strategic, clinical, health-economic, and competitive factors considered. Supports regulatory transparency requirements and internal audit.']
  regulatory_submission_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number of the regulatory submission (e.g., NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD sequence) associated with this pricing decision. Links pricing to the regulatory approval that enables commercialization.']
  reimbursement_status varchar [note: 'Current reimbursement status of the product under this pricing decision in the target market. Determines patient access and payer coverage scope.']
  target_price decimal(18,4) [note: 'Optimal or target price within the approved price corridor, representing the commercially preferred price point balancing access, revenue, and IRP risk. Expressed in currency_code.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area classification of the product subject to this pricing decision (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Used for portfolio-level pricing analytics and HTA benchmarking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pricing decision record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.']

  Note: 'Master record for formal pricing decisions, approved price corridors, and international reference pricing (IRP) management for pharmaceutical products across markets and channels. Captures list price (WAC/ex-factory), government reference price, IRP constraints, price change type, effective date, approving authority, pricing rationale, and approved price corridors including floor price, target price, ceiling price, IRP basket countries, monitoring frequency, and corridor breach alert thresholds. Serves as the authoritative record of approved prices and price bands, enabling proactive management of cross-country price erosion risk and launch sequencing optimization.'

SSOT for all coverage and reimbursement policy data within the market access domain. Enables access gap analysis, policy change monitoring, coverage landscape tracking, and coverage decision audit trails.'

  measurement_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the current or most recent outcome measurement period, after which observed outcomes are locked for reconciliation.']
  measurement_period_months varchar [note: 'Duration in months of each outcome measurement period over which patient cohort outcomes are observed and aggregated before reconciliation is triggered.']
  measurement_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the current or most recent outcome measurement period for which data collection and patient cohort tracking is active.']
  most_favored_nation_clause boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this outcomes-based contract includes a Most Favored Nation (MFN) clause, requiring that the payer receives terms no less favorable than those offered to any other payer.']
  observed_outcome_rate decimal(18,6) [note: 'Actual measured value of the outcome metric for the patient cohort during the measurement period (e.g., observed ORR of 0.58 or 58%). Compared against performance_threshold_value to determine rebate adjustment.']
  outcome_metric_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary clinical or economic outcome metric used to evaluate contract performance (e.g., \'Overall Response Rate\', \'Progression-Free Survival at 12 months\', \'Hospital Readmission Rate\', \'HbA1c Reduction\').']
  outcome_metric_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the outcome metric: clinical (e.g., ORR, OS, PFS), economic (e.g., cost per QALY, hospitalization cost), patient_reported (e.g., QoL score), or composite (combination of multiple endpoints).']
  patient_cohort_size varchar [note: 'Number of eligible patients included in the outcome measurement cohort for the measurement period, used to validate statistical significance and rebate calculation.']
  performance_threshold_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Numeric threshold value for the outcome metric that triggers rebate adjustments. For example, an ORR threshold of 0.65 (65%) or a PFS threshold of 12.0 months. Compared against observed outcome rate during reconciliation.']
  rebate_adjustment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary value of the rebate adjustment triggered by outcome performance variance, expressed in the contract currency. Used for gross-to-net revenue management and financial accruals.']
  rebate_adjustment_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Incremental rebate percentage adjustment triggered by the observed outcome variance from threshold. Applied on top of the base rebate to compute the total rebate owed for the measurement period.']
  reconciliation_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which outcome measurements are reconciled and rebate adjustments are calculated and invoiced to the payer (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual).']
  reconciliation_lag_days varchar [note: 'Number of days after the measurement period end date allowed for data collection, outcome adjudication, and reconciliation completion before rebate payment is due.']
  rwe_study_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or protocol number of the Real-World Evidence (RWE) or Real-World Data (RWD) study that underpins the outcome measurement methodology for this contract.']
  target_indication varchar [note: 'Specific disease indication or approved label for which outcomes are being measured under this contract (e.g., \'Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer – 1L\').']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area covered by this contract (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular), aligning with the company\'s portfolio taxonomy.']
  threshold_direction varchar [note: 'Specifies whether the observed outcome must be above, below, or equal to the threshold to meet the performance target (e.g., \'above\' for ORR, \'below\' for readmission rate).']
  threshold_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the performance threshold value (e.g., \'percentage\', \'months\', \'score\', \'events_per_100_patients\', \'USD\').']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this outcomes-based contract record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change management tracking.']
  variance_from_threshold decimal(18,6) [note: 'Calculated difference between the observed outcome rate and the performance threshold value (observed minus threshold). Positive values indicate outperformance; negative values indicate underperformance triggering rebate adjustment.']

  Note: 'Master record for outcomes-based, value-based, or risk-sharing agreements negotiated with payers where rebates or payments are contingent on demonstrated real-world clinical or economic outcomes. Captures outcome metric definition, measurement methodology, data source, performance thresholds, rebate adjustment schedule, measurement period, and reconciliation process. Also records transactional outcome measurements including observed outcome rates per measurement period, patient cohort sizes, variance from thresholds, and resulting rebate adjustment triggers. Supports the growing portfolio of innovative contracting arrangements with full measurement-to-reconciliation traceability.'
}

  Note: 'This association product represents the strategic engagement plan between a market access strategy and a Key Opinion Leader (KOL). It captures the specific role, engagement tier, activity targets, and effectiveness metrics for each KOL\'s participation in a given access strategy. Each record links one access_strategy to one hcp_kol_profile with attributes that exist only in the context of this strategic engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, a single access strategy (e.g., launch strategy for a new oncology drug in Germany) engages multiple KOLs across different roles (advisory board members, HTA expert witnesses, publication authors, congress speakers), and each prominent KOL participates in multiple access strategies across different products, indications, and geographies. The business actively manages these engagements as \'KOL Engagement Plans\' with specific roles, activity targets, budgets, and effectiveness tracking for each strategy-KOL combination.'

  Note: 'This association product represents the data sourcing relationship between HEOR studies and RWE datasets. It captures which real-world evidence datasets are used in which HEOR studies, including the role of the dataset in the study, the specific data vintage used, and the contribution characteristics. Each record links one HEOR study to one RWE dataset with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific data sourcing relationship, enabling tracking of dataset reuse across studies and supporting regulatory compliance requirements for model reproducibility.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical market access operations, HEOR studies routinely integrate multiple RWE datasets (claims, EMR, registries) to generate comprehensive evidence, and strategic RWE datasets are reused across multiple studies to maximize ROI on expensive data acquisition costs. The business actively manages this relationship as \'Study Data Sourcing\' with specific attributes (dataset role, contribution type, vintage used, patient counts) that belong to neither the study nor the dataset alone but to each specific study-dataset pairing. This is an operational relationship that HEOR teams create, track, and query for regulatory compliance and model reproducibility.'
}

Table hcp.engagement {
  engagement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for engagement']

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational relationship between healthcare professionals and pharmaceutical company employees (MSLs, medical directors, clinical scientists) in medical affairs field operations. It captures the ongoing professional engagement relationship including therapeutic area focus, interaction patterns, relationship strength metrics, and territory assignments. Each record links one HCP to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this professional engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In pharmaceutical medical affairs operations, multiple employees (MSLs, medical directors, clinical scientists) simultaneously maintain distinct professional engagement relationships with the same HCP across different therapeutic areas, territories, and functional roles. Conversely, each employee manages ongoing relationships with multiple HCPs as part of their territory assignment. The business actively manages these relationships as operational entities with specific attributes (relationship type, therapeutic area focus, engagement frequency, strength scoring, territory assignment, primary contact designation) that belong to neither the HCP nor the employee alone but to the relationship itself.'
}

  legal_status varchar [note: 'Current legal standing of the patent in its jurisdiction lifecycle. Pending indicates application under examination; granted indicates active protection; abandoned/lapsed indicates failure to prosecute or maintain; opposed indicates third-party challenge; litigated indicates active court proceedings. Drives LOE planning and portfolio valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|granted|abandoned|expired|lapsed|opposed|litigated — promote to reference product]']
  litigation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this patent is currently subject to active litigation, including Paragraph IV ANDA challenges, inter partes review (IPR), post-grant review (PGR), or district court infringement proceedings. Triggers escalated monitoring and legal counsel coordination.']
  maintenance_fee_due_date date [note: 'Next scheduled date by which maintenance (annuity) fees must be paid to the patent office to keep the patent in force. Failure to pay results in lapse of patent rights. Critical for IP portfolio maintenance operations.']
  orange_book_listed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this patent is listed in the FDA Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations (Orange Book). Orange Book listing triggers Paragraph IV certification obligations for ANDA filers and is central to Hatch-Waxman litigation strategy.']
  orphan_drug_exclusivity_expiry date [note: 'Date on which orphan drug market exclusivity expires, granting 7 years (US) or 10 years (EU) of market protection for drugs treating rare diseases. Distinct from patent expiry and critical for rare disease portfolio lifecycle planning.']
  ownership_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the company\'s relationship to the patent. Owned indicates full proprietary ownership; licensed_in indicates rights acquired from a third party; licensed_out indicates rights granted to a third party; co_owned indicates joint ownership; assigned indicates transfer of ownership has occurred.']
  patent_number varchar [note: 'Officially assigned patent number issued by the relevant patent office (e.g., USPTO, EPO, WIPO). Serves as the primary external business identifier for the patent. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., US10123456B2, EP3456789A1).']
  patent_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the patent by the nature of the invention. Composition of matter covers the active molecule (NCE/NBE); method of use covers therapeutic indications; formulation covers drug product design; process covers manufacturing methods; polymorph and salt form cover physical-chemical variants. Critical for LOE (Loss of Exclusivity) strategy and generic/biosimilar entry defense.']
  pediatric_exclusivity_expiry date [note: 'Date on which the 6-month pediatric exclusivity extension expires, granted by the FDA under the Best Pharmaceuticals for Children Act (BPCA) for conducting pediatric studies. Attaches to and extends both patent and data exclusivity periods.']
  priority_date date [note: 'Earliest claimed priority date, typically the date of the first-filed application in the patent family (provisional or national phase). Determines prior art cutoff and is critical for freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses and validity challenges.']
  prosecution_status varchar [note: 'Detailed status of the patent application within the prosecution workflow at the patent office. Provides granular tracking beyond legal_status for IP counsel and patent attorneys managing active applications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|examination|office_action|response_pending|allowed|granted|abandoned — promote to reference product]']
  purple_book_listed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this patent is listed in the FDA Purple Book (List of Licensed Biological Products). Relevant for biologics and biosimilar entry defense under the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA).']
  spc_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC) expires, representing the final end of patent-based market exclusivity in the relevant EU jurisdiction. Null if no SPC applies.']
  spc_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC) granted in EU member states to extend patent protection beyond the standard 20-year term to compensate for regulatory review time. Null if no SPC has been granted.']
  term_adjustment_days varchar [note: 'Number of days added to the patent term by the USPTO as Patent Term Adjustment (PTA) to compensate for delays in patent prosecution caused by the USPTO. Directly impacts the effective expiry date calculation.']
  term_extension_days varchar [note: 'Number of days added to the patent term under 35 U.S.C. § 156 (US) to compensate for time lost during FDA regulatory review of the drug product. Maximum extension is 5 years; total remaining term cannot exceed 14 years post-approval.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Primary therapeutic area or disease category addressed by the patented compound or method (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular, Neuroscience). Aligns with the company\'s R&D portfolio structure and supports commercial lifecycle planning.']
  title varchar [note: 'Official title of the patent as filed and granted by the patent office. Describes the invention in human-readable form and is used for portfolio reporting and IP management.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this patent record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  veeva_vault_doc_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier linking this patent record to the corresponding document stored in Veeva Vault (RIM or QualityDocs module), where the patent application, grant certificate, and related correspondence are archived. Supports traceability to the system of record for IP documents.']

  Note: 'Core master record for all pharmaceutical patents owned or licensed by the company. Captures patent number, title, filing/grant/expiry dates, patent family reference, jurisdiction, patent type (composition of matter, method of use, formulation, process, polymorph, salt form), covered compound (INN/USAN), therapeutic area, legal status, and assignee. Also serves as the anchor for trade secrets and know-how records via asset classification. SSOT for the IP portfolio — anchors lifecycle management, LOE planning, litigation defense, and generic/biosimilar entry strategy.'
}

Veeva Vault RIM is the primary system of record for IP and regulatory data in the pharmaceutical enterprise.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The calculated expiration date of the patent claim, accounting for standard 20-year patent term from filing date, patent term adjustments (PTA), and patent term extensions (PTE) granted for regulatory review delays under Hatch-Waxman or SPC in Europe. Critical for lifecycle management and loss-of-exclusivity (LOE) planning.']

  ipr_petition_number varchar [note: 'The official PTAB (Patent Trial and Appeal Board) or EPO Opposition Division case number for any active or completed inter partes review (IPR) or opposition proceeding challenging this claim.   is_orange_book_listed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this claim is associated with a patent listed in the FDA Orange Book (Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations).   is_purple_book_listed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this claim is associated with a patent listed in the FDA Purple Book (Lists of Licensed Biological Products).   last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this patent claim record was most recently modified in the IP management system. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization with Veeva Vault RIM and external patent docketing systems.']
  litigation_case_reference varchar [note: 'Court case number or docket reference for any active or completed patent infringement litigation involving this claim (e.g., Paragraph IV ANDA litigation, biosimilar patent dance disputes). Classified confidential due to legal privilege sensitivity. Null if no litigation is associated.']
  molecule_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the molecule or biological entity protected by this claim. NCE (New Chemical Entity) for small molecules; NBE (New Biological Entity) for large molecule biologics; biosimilar for follow-on biologics; vaccine, gene therapy, or cell therapy for advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs). Determines applicable regulatory pathway and exclusivity provisions.']
  outside_counsel_firm varchar [note: 'Name of the external law firm engaged to prosecute or defend this claim. Classified confidential due to legal privilege and commercial sensitivity. Used for matter management, billing reconciliation, and legal spend tracking.']
  parent_claim_number varchar [note: 'For dependent claims, the claim number of the parent claim from which this claim depends. Null for independent claims. Used to reconstruct claim dependency trees for infringement and validity analyses.']
  patent_office_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the patent office where this claim was filed or is being prosecuted. USPTO (US), EPO (European), UKIPO (UK post-Brexit), JPO (Japan), CNIPA (China), WIPO (PCT international). Determines applicable procedural rules and examination standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USPTO|EPO|UKIPO|JPO|CNIPA|WIPO|PMDA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  patent_term_extension_months varchar [note: 'Number of months of patent term extension granted to compensate for regulatory review delays during NDA/BLA/MAA approval processes. In the US, PTE is granted under 35 U.S.C. § 156 (Hatch-Waxman); in Europe, via Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC). Directly impacts loss-of-exclusivity (LOE) date calculations.']
  prosecution_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the claim within the patent prosecution lifecycle at the relevant patent office. Pending claims are under examination; allowed claims have been approved but not yet granted; granted claims are part of an issued patent; rejected claims received a final office action; abandoned claims were not pursued further.']
  spc_number varchar [note: 'The official reference number of the Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC) granted in EU member states for this claim. SPCs extend effective patent protection for up to 5 years post-patent expiry for medicinal products that required regulatory approval. Null if no SPC has been granted.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication covered by this claim (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company\'s portfolio therapeutic areas and is used for lifecycle management, LOE planning, and commercial strategy coordination.']
  validity_status varchar [note: 'Current legal standing of the claim. Valid claims are enforceable; invalid claims have been found unpatentable; cancelled claims were withdrawn during prosecution or post-grant proceedings; amended claims were modified during IPR or reexamination; under_review indicates active challenge proceedings; stayed indicates enforcement is paused pending litigation outcome.']

  Note: 'Individual claims within a granted or pending patent, capturing claim number, claim type (independent, dependent), claim text, claim scope classification (broad, narrow, genus, species), and validity status. Critical for freedom-to-operate analyses, infringement assessments, and generic/biosimilar entry defense strategies. Each claim has its own legal standing and may be challenged independently during inter partes review (IPR) or opposition proceedings.'
}

  exclusivity_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the regulatory exclusivity type granted. NCE = New Chemical Entity (5 years US); ODE = Orphan Drug Exclusivity (7 years US / 10 years EU); PED = Pediatric Exclusivity Extension (6 months); DATA = Data Exclusivity for new indication (3 years US); BIOL = Biologics Exclusivity (12 years US); REMS = Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy exclusivity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NCE|ODE|PED|DATA|BIOL|REMS|NME|PATENT_LINKAGE — promote to reference product]']
  first_generic_entry_date date [note: 'The projected or actual date on which the first generic (ANDA) or biosimilar (351(k) BLA) product may enter the market following expiry or challenge of this exclusivity. Used for lifecycle management, revenue forecasting, and LOE (Loss of Exclusivity) planning.']
  granting_authority varchar [note: 'Regulatory authority that granted this exclusivity period (e.g., FDA for US market, EMA for EU market, PMDA for Japan, MHRA for UK post-Brexit). Determines jurisdiction and applicable exclusivity rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|NMPA|WHO|DEA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  indication varchar [note: 'The specific disease or condition for which the product is approved and for which this exclusivity was granted. Particularly important for new indication (3-year data exclusivity) and orphan drug exclusivity where exclusivity is indication-specific.']
  is_orphan_designated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the product holds an orphan drug designation from FDA (Orphan Drug Act) or EMA (Regulation EC 141/2000), which is a prerequisite for orphan drug exclusivity (ODE). Distinct from exclusivity_type as designation may exist without exclusivity being granted.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this exclusivity period record, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records regulations.']
  legal_counsel_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes from legal counsel regarding this exclusivity period, including litigation strategy, challenge responses, and coordination with patent attorneys. Classified as confidential due to potential attorney-client privilege content.']
  lifecycle_stage varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle management stage of the product relative to this exclusivity period. Pre-Approval = exclusivity anticipated but not yet granted; Active Protection = exclusivity in force; LOE Watch = within 24 months of expiry requiring active monitoring; Post-Expiry = exclusivity has lapsed.']
  loe_risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessed risk level for Loss of Exclusivity (LOE) based on proximity to expiry, challenge status, and competitive pipeline. Critical for commercial lifecycle management and strategic planning.']
  orphan_designation_number varchar [note: 'Official orphan drug designation number assigned by FDA (ODA) or EMA (EC Regulation 141/2000) when exclusivity_type is ODE. Required for orphan drug exclusivity validation and regulatory reporting.']
  patent_linkage_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this exclusivity period is linked to a listed patent in the FDA Orange Book or equivalent patent register, enabling coordination between patent protection and regulatory exclusivity for lifecycle management.']
  pediatric_extension_expiry_date date [note: 'The adjusted expiry date reflecting the 6-month pediatric exclusivity extension, if granted. Null if pediatric_extension_granted is False.']
  pediatric_extension_granted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a 6-month pediatric exclusivity extension (PED) has been granted under the Best Pharmaceuticals for Children Act (BPCA) or EU Paediatric Regulation, extending the base exclusivity or patent term by 6 months.']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'The specific statutory or regulatory provision under which this exclusivity was granted (e.g., 21 CFR 314.108(b)(2) for NCE, Orphan Drug Act Section 527, BPCIA Section 7002, EU Regulation 141/2000 Article 8). Supports legal and regulatory audit trails.']
  rems_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) is required as a condition of approval for this product, which may confer additional exclusivity protections or market access restrictions relevant to generic entry.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'The route by which the drug product is administered (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical). Exclusivity may be route-specific, particularly for new indication or new formulation exclusivity.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this exclusivity period data was sourced (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, FDA Orange Book feed, EMA EPAR, SAP S/4HANA). Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease category associated with the approved indication (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neurology, Cardiovascular). Used for portfolio segmentation and LOE impact analysis by therapeutic area.']

  Note: 'Tracks all regulatory exclusivity periods granted to pharmaceutical products, distinct from patent protection. Covers orphan drug exclusivity (7 years US / 10 years EU), data exclusivity (5 years NCE / 3 years new indication), pediatric exclusivity extension (6 months), new chemical entity exclusivity, biologics exclusivity (12 years US), and REMS exclusivity. Captures exclusivity type, granting authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA), start date, expiry date, product reference, and associated NDA/BLA/MAA number. Critical for lifecycle management and generic/biosimilar entry defense.'
}

  nice_class_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of Nice Classification class numbers (1–45) under which the trademark is registered.   notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional remarks, prosecution history notes, strategic comments, or legal observations relevant to the trademark record that are not captured in structured fields.']
  office_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the trademark office or registry where the application was filed or registration is held (e.g., USPTO for United States, EUIPO for European Union, UKIPO for United Kingdom, JPO for Japan, CNIPA for China, WIPO for international registrations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USPTO|EUIPO|UKIPO|JPO|CNIPA|WIPO|CIPO|IP_AUSTRALIA — promote to reference product]']
  opposition_deadline_date date [note: 'The date by which third parties may file an opposition to the trademark application in the relevant jurisdiction. Critical for monitoring the application\'s progress toward registration and for assessing third-party challenge risk.']
  opposition_status varchar [note: 'Current status of any opposition proceedings against the trademark application: not_opposed (no opposition filed), opposition_filed (third-party opposition pending), opposition_withdrawn (opponent withdrew), or opposition_decided (proceeding concluded by the trademark office).']
  owner_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the trademark owner\'s country of domicile or incorporation, as recorded in the trademark register.']

  product_launch_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market where the associated pharmaceutical drug product is commercially launched or planned for launch under this trademark. Links trademark protection to commercial launch activities.']
  registration_date date [note: 'The date on which the trademark was officially registered by the trademark office. Marks the start of the initial registration term and triggers renewal obligation tracking.']
  registration_number varchar [note: 'The official registration number assigned by the trademark office upon successful registration of the mark. Serves as the externally-known unique identifier for the trademark in the relevant jurisdiction.']
  registration_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the trademark registration: pending (application filed, under examination), registered (officially granted), opposed (subject to third-party opposition proceedings), cancelled (registration revoked), expired (lapsed due to non-renewal), or abandoned (application withdrawn or lapsed).   renewal_reminder_date date [note: 'The internal reminder date set for initiating the trademark renewal process, typically set a defined number of months before the official renewal_date. Supports proactive renewal management and avoidance of unintentional lapse.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease category for which the associated drug product is indicated (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Supports portfolio segmentation and brand strategy analytics.']
  trademark_name varchar [note: 'The brand name, word mark, or slogan that is the subject of the trademark registration (e.g., a proprietary drug brand name). Serves as the primary human-readable identity label for the trademark record.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the trademark record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, change tracking, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  use_anywhere_date date [note: 'The date on which the trademark was first used anywhere (not necessarily in commerce) in connection with the identified goods/services. Relevant for establishing priority in use-based trademark systems.']
  use_in_commerce_date date [note: 'The date on which the trademark was first used in commerce in connection with the goods/services identified in the registration.   Note: 'Master record for all pharmaceutical trademark registrations including brand names, logos, trade dress, and slogans. Captures trademark name, registration number, filing date, registration date, expiry/renewal date, jurisdiction, Nice classification, goods and services description, trademark type (word mark, figurative, combined), owner entity, and current status (pending, registered, opposed, cancelled). Supports brand protection strategy and commercial launch activities.'
}

  diligence_obligations varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the commercially reasonable efforts or best efforts diligence obligations imposed on the licensee to develop and commercialize the licensed product. Failure to meet diligence obligations may trigger termination rights. Used for partner relationship management and compliance monitoring.']
  dispute_resolution_mechanism varchar [note: 'Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between the parties. Arbitration: binding arbitration under specified rules (e.g., ICC, AAA). Litigation: resolution through courts of the governing jurisdiction. Mediation: non-binding mediation before escalation. Expert-determination: technical disputes resolved by independent expert.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the licensing agreement becomes legally binding and operative. Marks the start of the agreement term for royalty accrual, exclusivity period calculation, and milestone tracking. Corresponds to EFFECTIVE_FROM for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.']
  exclusivity_type varchar [note: 'Scope of exclusivity granted under the license. Exclusive: licensee is the sole permitted user in the territory/field. Non-exclusive: licensor may grant same rights to others. Co-exclusive: limited number of licensees permitted. Semi-exclusive: licensor retains right to practice but not to license others. Critical for generic/biosimilar entry defense strategy.']
  execution_date date [note: 'Date on which the licensing agreement was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective date if the agreement has a retroactive or future effective date. Used for legal record-keeping and audit trails.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the licensing agreement naturally expires at the end of its agreed term. Nullable for perpetual or open-ended agreements. Drives lifecycle management alerts, renewal negotiations, and IP exclusivity planning. Corresponds to EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the MASTER_AGREEMENT role.']
  field_of_use varchar [note: 'Specific therapeutic area, indication, or application domain within which the licensee is permitted to use the licensed IP. Examples: \'oncology\', \'rare diseases\', \'human therapeutics only\', \'diagnostic use\'. Restricts the scope of the license and is critical for exclusivity analysis and sublicensing rights management.']
  governing_law varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the agreement. Determines applicable contract law, dispute resolution procedures, and regulatory compliance obligations.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the licensing agreement record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED audit trail required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and change control tracking.']
  legal_counsel_reference varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the internal or external legal counsel responsible for drafting, negotiating, and maintaining the agreement. Used for coordination on patent litigation, IP enforcement, and contract amendments.']
  licensed_asset_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the intellectual property assets covered by the license, including compound names (INN/USAN), patent numbers, know-how, trade secrets, trademarks, or biological sequences. Supports IP portfolio management and freedom-to-operate analysis.']
  licensed_asset_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the primary intellectual property asset type covered by the agreement. Patent: granted patent rights. Know-how: proprietary technical knowledge. Trademark: brand or trade name rights. Data-package: regulatory data exclusivity or clinical data. Biological-sequence: gene or protein sequence rights. Trade-secret: confidential proprietary information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patent|know-how|trademark|data-package|biological-sequence|trade-secret|formulation|process — promote to reference product]']
  licensee_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the party receiving the license (the licensee). For in-licensing agreements, this is typically the company itself. For out-licensing, this is the external counterparty receiving rights. Used in legal documentation, royalty accounting, and partner relationship management.']
  milestone_count varchar [note: 'Total number of contractually defined milestone events (development, regulatory, and commercial) specified in the agreement. Used for milestone tracking dashboards, deal management reporting, and ASC 606 performance obligation identification.']
  regulatory_milestone_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Aggregate value of all regulatory milestone payments (e.g., NDA/BLA/MAA submission, FDA/EMA approval) defined in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Supports regulatory affairs planning and ASC 606 variable consideration estimation.']
  responsible_party varchar [note: 'Identifies which party bears primary responsibility for conducting development activities (clinical trials, regulatory submissions, manufacturing scale-up) under the agreement. Licensor: licensor retains development responsibility. Licensee: licensee assumes development responsibility. Joint: shared responsibility as defined in the agreement.']
  right_of_first_negotiation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement grants either party a right of first negotiation (ROFN) for additional territories, indications, or follow-on compounds. True = ROFN exists; False = no ROFN. Relevant for lifecycle management and business development strategy.']
  royalty_base varchar [note: 'The contractual basis on which royalties are calculated. Net-sales: royalties applied to net sales after standard deductions. Gross-sales: royalties applied to gross sales before deductions. Net-revenue: royalties applied to net revenue. Units-sold: royalties calculated per unit sold. Determines the royalty accounting methodology.']
  royalty_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'Contractual royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction of net sales (e.g., 0.050000 = 5.0%) payable by the licensee to the licensor. Used for royalty accrual calculations, revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15, and P&L forecasting. Null if the agreement uses a tiered royalty structure captured in a separate milestone/royalty schedule.']
  sap_contract_number varchar [note: 'Contract number assigned in SAP S/4HANA (SD or FI module) for financial processing of royalty payments, milestone invoicing, and upfront fee recognition. Enables reconciliation between the IP portfolio system and the ERP for royalty accounting and revenue recognition.']
  sublicensing_permitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the licensee has the contractual right to sublicense the licensed IP to third parties (e.g., CMOs, CDMOs, or sub-distributors). True = sublicensing permitted; False = sublicensing prohibited. Impacts CMO/CDMO engagement and supply chain structuring.']
  termination_conditions varchar [note: 'Summary of the contractual conditions under which either party may terminate the agreement, including material breach cure periods, insolvency triggers, regulatory failure events, and convenience termination rights. Used by legal counsel for contract management and risk assessment.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the licensing agreement was terminated prior to its natural expiry, whether by mutual consent, breach, or exercise of termination rights. Null if the agreement has not been terminated. Used for financial close-out and IP rights reversion tracking.']
  total_deal_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total potential deal value including upfront payments, all milestone payments, and estimated royalties over the agreement term, expressed in the agreement currency. Used for deal valuation, P&L forecasting, and investor disclosure. Represents the gross deal value before probability-weighting.']
  total_milestone_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Sum of all contractually defined milestone payment amounts across all milestone events in the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Represents the maximum milestone-based consideration achievable under the agreement. Used for deal valuation and revenue recognition planning.']
  upfront_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'One-time upfront license fee or signing payment due at execution of the agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. Recognized as revenue or capitalized as an intangible asset depending on the nature of the license under ASC 606/IFRS 15. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this MASTER_AGREEMENT.']
  veeva_vault_document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of the fully executed agreement document stored in Veeva Vault (RIM or QualityDocs module). Enables direct navigation from the data product record to the source legal document for audit, due diligence, and regulatory inspection purposes. Aligns with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.']

  Note: 'Records all IP licensing agreements (in-licensing, out-licensing, cross-licensing, co-development, collaboration) including deal terms, milestone obligations, and milestone payment tracking. Captures agreement type, parties, licensed assets, territory, field of use, exclusivity scope, royalty structure, milestone events (regulatory filing, IND submission, phase completion, NDA approval, first commercial sale, sales thresholds), milestone descriptions, trigger events, milestone due dates, achieved dates, milestone payment amounts, currency, payment status, responsible party, sublicensing rights, and termination conditions. Supports deal management, milestone tracking, revenue recognition (ASC 606), royalty accounting, and partner relationship management.'
}

Table intellectual.royalty_payment {
  royalty_payment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each royalty payment transaction record within the intellectual property portfolio management system.']
  journal_entry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Every royalty payment (in or out) generates a GL posting for revenue/expense recognition. Finance links royalty payments to journal entries for reconciliation, audit trail, SOX compliance, and revenue']
  licensing_agreement_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the licensing agreement under which this royalty payment is made or received. Links the payment to the governing contract terms.']
  medicinal_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Royalty payments calculated on product-specific net sales. Essential for financial reporting, deal reconciliation, and product-level P&L attribution. Removes denormalized licensed_product_name.']
  patent_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the patent or intellectual property asset (NCE, NBE, formulation, or process patent) that is the subject of the royalty-bearing license.']
  primary_royalty_business_partner_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the party granting the license (the entity receiving royalty payments in an outbound scenario or paying in an inbound scenario).']
  responsible_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pharmaceutical finance assigns employees to reconcile royalty payments for calculation validation, dispute resolution, and treasury coordination. Critical for revenue recognition, audit trail, and SOX']
  adjustment_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Any adjustments applied to the calculated royalty amount, such as corrections from prior period reconciliations, audit findings, or contractual true-ups. Positive values increase the payment; negative values reduce it.']
  audit_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this royalty payment record has been flagged for formal royalty audit review, typically triggered by discrepancies between reported sales and expected royalty amounts or by contractual audit rights.']
  bank_reference_number varchar [note: 'Bank-issued transaction reference number or wire transfer confirmation number associated with the royalty payment. Used for bank reconciliation and payment verification.']
  calculation_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the royalty calculation period for which net sales or units sold are being reported and royalties computed. Together with start date defines the reporting window per the licensing agreement.']
  calculation_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the royalty calculation period (e.g., quarter or year) for which net sales or units sold are being reported and royalties computed. Aligns with licensing agreement reporting obligations.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'SAP cost center code to which the royalty payment expense or income is allocated for internal management accounting and P&L reporting purposes.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this royalty payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the royalty payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Determines the denomination of all monetary amounts in this record.']
  deductions_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Total allowable deductions applied to gross sales to arrive at net sales, as defined in the licensing agreement. Typically includes chargebacks, rebates, returns, freight, and applicable taxes.']
  dispute_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason for disputing the royalty payment amount, applicable when payment_status is \'disputed\'. Documents the basis for disagreement between licensor and licensee for legal and audit purposes.']
  due_date date [note: 'Contractual deadline by which the royalty payment must be made as specified in the licensing agreement. Used to track overdue payments and trigger escalation workflows.']
  exchange_rate decimal(18,8) [note: 'Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to the company\'s functional reporting currency at the time of payment. Required for multi-currency licensing agreements and consolidated financial reporting.']
  functional_currency_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Total payment amount converted to the company\'s functional reporting currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated P&L reporting and SOX financial controls.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'SAP General Ledger account code to which this royalty payment is posted for financial reporting purposes. Distinguishes royalty income (inbound) from royalty expense (outbound) in the P&L.']
  gross_sales_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Total gross sales revenue generated from the licensed product during the calculation period, before any deductions. Used as the starting point for net sales calculation per the licensing agreement definition.']
  licensed_territory varchar [note: 'Geographic territory or market for which the royalty payment applies, as defined in the licensing agreement. May be a country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), region, or \'GLOBAL\'. Supports territory-level royalty analytics.']
  minimum_royalty_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Contractual minimum royalty amount guaranteed per period as specified in the licensing agreement, regardless of actual sales performance. Applicable when the calculated royalty falls below this floor.']
  net_sales_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Net sales revenue for the licensed product during the calculation period, calculated as gross sales minus allowable deductions per the licensing agreement definition. Forms the royalty basis for net-sales-based agreements.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the royalty payment was executed (funds transferred or received). Represents the principal real-world business event date for this transaction.']
  payment_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the royalty payment is inbound (received by the company as licensor) or outbound (paid by the company as licensee). Critical for P&L classification and financial reporting.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the royalty payment (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check, offset against receivables, or netting against other obligations).']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this royalty payment transaction, typically matching the SAP FI document number or bank remittance reference used for reconciliation and audit trail.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the royalty payment transaction. Tracks progression from draft calculation through approval, payment execution, and final settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending|approved|paid|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the royalty payment reconciliation process, indicating whether the payment has been matched against the licensee\'s royalty report and confirmed as accurate. Supports royalty audit workflows.']
  royalty_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Calculated royalty amount due for the calculation period, derived by applying the royalty rate to the applicable royalty basis (net sales, gross sales, or units sold). This is the principal monetary fact of the transaction.']
  royalty_basis varchar [note: 'The contractual basis upon which the royalty is calculated, as defined in the licensing agreement. Common bases include net sales, gross sales, units sold, milestone achievements, or sublicense revenue.']
  royalty_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'The contractual royalty rate applied to the royalty basis (expressed as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.05 for 5%). May be tiered based on sales thresholds as defined in the licensing agreement. Classified confidential as it reflects proprietary deal terms.']
  royalty_report_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number or identifier of the royalty statement or sales report submitted by the licensee that forms the basis for this royalty payment calculation. Links the payment to the supporting documentation.']
  royalty_tier_label varchar [note: 'Label identifying the applicable royalty tier when the licensing agreement specifies tiered rates based on cumulative net sales thresholds (e.g., \'Tier 1: 0-$100M\', \'Tier 2: $100M-$500M\'). Null if the agreement uses a flat rate.']
  therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'Therapeutic area classification of the licensed drug product (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases). Supports portfolio-level royalty analytics and strategic lifecycle management decisions.']
  total_payment_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Final net royalty payment amount after applying the royalty rate to the basis, enforcing any minimum royalty floor, and incorporating adjustments. This is the amount actually paid or received.']
  units_sold decimal(20,4) [note: 'Number of units of the licensed product sold during the calculation period. Used as the royalty basis for unit-based royalty agreements. Expressed as DECIMAL to accommodate partial units or volume-based measures.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this royalty payment record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  withholding_tax_amount decimal(20,4) [note: 'Amount of withholding tax deducted from the royalty payment at source, as required by applicable tax treaties between the licensor and licensee jurisdictions. Relevant for cross-border licensing arrangements.']
  withholding_tax_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'Applicable withholding tax rate (expressed as a decimal fraction) applied to the royalty payment based on the tax treaty between the relevant jurisdictions. Used to validate withholding tax amount calculations.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of royalty payments made or received under licensing agreements. Captures payment date, payment direction (inbound/outbound), royalty basis (net sales, units sold), royalty rate applied, calculation period, gross sales, net sales, deductions, royalty amount, currency, payment status, and reconciliation status. Supports financial reporting, royalty audits, and compliance with licensing agreement terms.'
}

  case_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the litigation case by legal mechanism. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|settled|dismissed|judgment_entered|appealed|stayed|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  plaintiff_name varchar [note: 'Legal name of the party initiating the litigation (typically the innovator/NDA holder asserting patent rights, or the generic/biosimilar applicant filing a declaratory judgment action). May be the company itself or a subsidiary.']
  revenue_at_risk_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Estimated annual revenue at risk if the litigation outcome is unfavorable and generic or biosimilar entry occurs earlier than the patent expiry date. Expressed in US dollars. Critical input for lifecycle management decisions and commercial strategy.']

  settlement_entry_date date [note: 'Agreed date on which the generic or biosimilar entrant is permitted to launch its product under the terms of the settlement agreement. Critical for lifecycle management and revenue forecasting. Null for non-settlement outcomes.']

  Note: 'Tracks active and historical patent litigation cases including Paragraph IV ANDA challenges, inter partes review (IPR) petitions, post-grant review (PGR), patent infringement suits, and declaratory judgment actions. Critical for generic/biosimilar entry defense strategy and legal budget management.'

  product_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the medicinal product covered by the SPC as a small molecule (New Chemical Entity/NCE), biologic (New Biological Entity/NBE), vaccine, combination product, or medical device combination.   rims_record_reference varchar [note: 'The record identifier in the Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS), specifically Veeva Vault RIM, that corresponds to this SPC filing.   spc_certificate_number varchar [note: 'The official certificate number assigned by the granting authority upon successful grant of the SPC.   spc_duration_months varchar [note: 'The duration of SPC protection expressed in months, calculated as the period between the basic patent filing date and the first marketing authorization date, minus 5 years, capped at a maximum of 60 months (5 years).   spc_expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which SPC protection expires, after which generic and biosimilar manufacturers may enter the market. This is the most critical date for lifecycle management, loss-of-exclusivity (LOE) planning, commercial forecasting, and generic/biosimilar entry defense strategy.   spc_filing_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the SPC filing action type.   spc_start_date date [note: 'The date on which SPC protection commences, which is the day immediately following the expiry of the basic patent.   therapeutic_area varchar [note: 'The therapeutic area or disease indication for which the medicinal product is authorized (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Used for IP portfolio segmentation, lifecycle management planning, and commercial strategy alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product aligned with ATC classification]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this SPC filing record was last modified in the intellectual property management system. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.']

  Note: 'Supplementary Protection Certificate (SPC) filings that extend patent protection for pharmaceutical products beyond the standard patent term to compensate for time lost during regulatory approval. Captures SPC application number, filing date, granting authority (national patent office), basic patent reference, marketing authorization number, product covered, SPC duration, expiry date, and status. Relevant primarily in EU, UK, and other jurisdictions offering SPC protection.'
